༄༅/ /dpal kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dka' gnad rnams dang log rtog sel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar legs bshad kun 'dus zhes ba

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI091_dpal kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dka' gnad rnams dang log rtog sel byed.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dka' gnad rnams dang log rtog sel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar legs bshad kun 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru bha ga wan bai ro tsa na ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rje btsun bla ma dang / /dbyer med dkyil 'khor gtso bo la btud nas/ /kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor cho ga yi/ /dka' gnad gsal byed legs bshad 'di spel lo/ /de la 'dir kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dka' ba'i gnad rnams dang log rtog sel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad kun 'dus zhes bya ba 'chad pa la don gsum te/ sngon gyi mkhas pa lo tsā ba ngag dbang grags pa'i gsung ltar bshad pa/ sa skya'i bstan 'dzin mtshungs med dpal ldan ngor pa'i rjes 'brang gi lugs ltar bshad pa/ chos rje rdzong pa'i bka' srol 'dzin pa'i lugs ltar bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni mkhas pa chen po sde snod gsum pa lo tsā ba ngag dbang grags pa la slob dpon mañdzu shrī la sogs pas bskul nas mdzad pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgrub pa la nye bar 'kho ba'i rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba'i gsung rabs las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ de la spyir dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i sgra du ma la 'jug ste/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes sogs ltar/ rten 'byung ba bzhi dang / de nyid 'dus pa'i dum bu gnyis pa'i/ ngan 'gro dgug cing sdig pa bral/ /ces sogs nas/ 'phros pa sbyong rgyud yin la/ 'di la 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug 'jig rten pa'i drug ste/ bcu gnyis yod pa'i dang po 'das pa'i drug ni/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shāka thub sku'i/ tshe dpag med gsung gi phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba yon tan gyi/ /me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor ro/

/'jig rten pa'i drug ni/ thams cad kyi gtso bo phyag na rdo rje la rgyal chen bzhis bskor ba/ phyogs skyongs bcu/ lha chen brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyis bskor ba/ phyag na rdo rje la 'jigs byed dgus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor te 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug go 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa ltar tshogs pa dang / lde gu'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa dang / gzhan dag zlum por bya zhes pa ltar/ dri'i thig le dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa ltar 'od zer phreng ba dang / rten gzhal yas khang dang / de la brten pa'i lha'i tshogs rnams la dkyil 'khor gyi sgra 'jug pa las/ 'dir phyi ma bzung ngo / /'dir nges pa'i tshig tu na/ maṇ+ḍal ste/ maṇ+ḍal snying po dang len pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang du/ dkyil ni snying po 'khor ni len pa'o/ /zhes dang / des na snying po len pa dkyil 'khor zhes kun snying gis bshad do/ /'di la dbye na gzugs can gzugs med kyi dkyil 'khor gnyis las/ de'ang mngon byung gi dbang du byas na sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi sems chen po ni/ gzugs med kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ ye shes des gdul bya'i don du ri rab kyi rtse mor gtso 'khor du mar sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang dbyibs kyi bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor ni gzugs can te/ sbyong rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs gyur pa'i/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying po gsungs/ /zhes dang / dpal mchog bstod 'grel du/ kha dog dang dbyibs kyi bdag nyid can gyi gzugs can gyi dkyil 'khor du gsungs pa yin te zhes gsungs so/ /rjes 'jug gi dbang du byas nas/ yid kyis sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ gzugs can ma yin pa dang / sa dang ras sogs la bris pa ni phyi gzugs can gyi dkyil 'khor te/ sbyong rgyud du/

sngar gyi rjes la phyi'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so zhes bshad do/ /de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor de sgrub pa la/ byed pa po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ sgrub pa po grogs kyi mtshan nyid/ sgrub pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid sogs rgyas par rdo rje rtse mo na yod de/ 'dir yi ge mang ba la 'jigs te ma bris so/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bya ba la 'jug pa'i thog mar/ khrus dang srung 'khor gsungs te/ rtse mor/ dang po kho nar khrus bya zhing / /de bzhin phyogs dag bcings pa dang / /log 'dren rnams kyang bcings byas te/ /gos dag gtsang mar bgo bya zhing / /zhes so/ /khrus 'di la nang gi khrus/ gsang ba'i khrus/ rnal 'byor gyi khrus/ phyi khrus dang bzhi las/ rtse mor/ sdom pa gsum la rab tu gnas/ /dang po'i khrus su brjod pa yin/ /gnyis pa rgyud las gsungs pa yi/ /sdig bshad gsol ba 'debs pa sogs/ /phyag rgya bcing ba gsum pa ste/ /bzhi pa chu te tha ma yin/ /zhes gsungs la/ khrus gsum pa ni phyag rgya 'grol ba la gzhan dag 'chad kyang / lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa yin pa kho bo sems so/ /dang po nang gi khrus la mtshan bcas dang / mtshan med gnyis te/ dang po sngar bshad pa'i sdom pa gsum la gnas pa sogs dang / gnyis pa bdag med bsgom pa'o zhes gnyan ston tshul 'bar gsungs pa legs shing / 'dir ni mtshan med ston te/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le'i rgyud du/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha haṃḥzhes te rang bzhin gyi dag pa nga yin zhes pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs su bi shud+dha 'byung ba ltar na/ rnal 'byor dag pa zhes bsnan no/ /paṇ+ḍi ta thub dbang bzang po na re/ bdag med sgom pa 'di sems kyi khrus/ lce byin gyis brlabs pa ngag gi khrus/ lag pa byin gyis rlabs pa lus kyi khrus bstan gsung ngo / /gnur pa swa bhā ba'i sngags ma bshad gsungs ba ni ches mi 'thad ste/ slob dpon kun snying gis rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'grel par/

rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs so/ /gos gtsang ma bgo ba'i don la/ rtse mor/ sdom pa la ni legs gnas pa/ /gos ni dang por brjod pa dang / /gnyis pa cho ga sgrub pa dang / /gsum pa ngo tsha khrel yod pa/ /gtsang ma'i gos ni gsum po dag /lan gsum du ni brje bar bya/ /zhes te/ cho ga sgrub pa 'di phyi'i gos gtsang mar/ bstod 'grel du bshad do/ /de nas chos thams cad bdag med cing de ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje bskyed de/ de dag sangs rgyas la 'god snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bzung / de na sgo gsum nus pa dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ gnas skabs thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar byed par/ dpal mchog nas bshad pa dang mthun par/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid me tog gang phog gi lhar mos ste/ 'dir ni de mtshon par phyag na rdo rje bsgom mo zhes bla ma rje btsun chen pos gsung ngo / /srung 'khor la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi bsdus pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ 'jig rten gsum la rnam rgyal gyi/ /bdag bsrungs la sogs byas nas ni/ /bdag gis de nyid dran byed cing / /sogs kyi rang don nyid phyag rdor gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ bsam/ hūm̐ gis sgras 'jig rten g.yos/ gdug pa can thams cad btul tshur 'dus pas bdag nyid khro bo sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa zhes sogs su bskyed do zhes rje btsun chen po gsung ngo / /'di la bi bhu ta tsan+t+ras 'jig rten gsum rgyal dang me ltar 'bar ba gcig tu byas te zhal bzhi phyag brgyad par bskyed pa dang / lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod gyi bshad pa 'jig rten gsum rgyal dang me ltar 'bar ba cig tu mdzad te/ rab zhal gsum phyag drug 'bring phyag bzhi/ tha ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mdzad zhes grags par bshad de/ de yang dpal mchog tu me ltar 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang /

rtse mor hūm̐ mdzad zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa dang / sbyong rgyud du/ khams su rnam rgyal dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa rnams byed par bshad pa dang 'dra'am snyam mo/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs te rtse mor/ oṃ ni ci zhig yin par bshad/ mchog dang nor ste dpal dang dbyangs/ /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes so/ /badz+ra satwa kro dha ni rdo rje sems dpa' khro bo/ a na me/ larkā shel dang / nyi ma dang rlangs gsum la 'jug kyang sngon 'bar bar bsgyur/ mahā badz+ra kro dha rdo rje khro bo chen po/ drwa ba drwa ba gnyis dros shig bros shig bi dra ba bi dra ba/ rnal 'byor bros shig gnyis/ sarba a pa ya ngan song thams cad/ nā sha ya/ nā shā ya/ gzhom par mdzod gnyis/ ha ra ha ra pra nan hūm̐ phaṭ/ phrogs phrogs srog rnams/ rtse mor/ yi ge hūm̐ ni ci yin brjod/ sdug bsngal 'chos shing 'joms par byed/ /srid pa'i zhags pa gshed byed cing / /gdug pa'ang dngas shing gsod byed pa'i/ /hūm̐ ni mchog tu dran par bya/ /zhes dang / yi ge phaṭ ni ci zhig yin/ /bdud dang sdug bsngal 'joms byed cing / /bde ba dag ni 'gugs par byed/ /phaṭ ni 'joms byed sgra yin te/ /grogs dang bcas pa 'joms par byed/ /gsum gsum gyis bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba 'di ni sbyong rgyud nas gsungs te bsdus pa'o/ /de'i steng du khro bo bstod pa ni 'bring yin no zhes rje btsun gsung ngo / /rgyas par byed na me tog gang phog gam/ phyag rdor du mos pa'i lkog ma'i phyogs mgrin par hriḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lce'i thad ka'i 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa chur nyal/ de zhu zla ba la thim/ zla ba zhu lce la thim/ lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam la/

oṃ badz+ra dzi hā zhes lan gsum brjod/ des sngags bzlos pas nus pa dang ldan par gyur ro/ /rlan sogs zla ba ma bshad ces dang / zla ba thim par bshad pa med zer ba mi rigs te/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung du/ lkog mar pad+ma rnam par bsam/ /mdun gyi pad+mar a dang ni/ /hūm̐ la zla ba rdo rje ni/ /rtse lnga bskyed de de yang ni/ /lce de nyid la thim par byas/ /rdo rje me ru rab bsam pas/ /sngags bzlos mthu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'byung bar/ lag pa gnyis su ni a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam ste/ de gnyis kyi steng du hūm̐ gnyis las rdo rje rtse lnga dkar po bsam zhing lag pa'i sor mo rnams kyi rdo rje rtse gcig par gyur pa bsam la bgegs bsal ba sogs bya zhes dang / de zhu bar yang kun snying gis/ lag pa'i dbus su zhu gyur nas/ /rdo rje yi ni lag par bsam/ /zhes so/ /'dir dar ma snying po na re/ sor mo re re'ang rdo rje rtse lnga par bsam la/ badz+ra ha sta brjod ces zer te/ sor mo re re rdo rje lnga par sgom pa slob dpon kun snying gis rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'grel par/ sor mo rdo rje rtse gcig par dngos su bshad pa dang 'gal la/ badz+ra ha sta brjod pa ma bshad kyang rgyu mthun 'ong bar kho bo sems so/ /de nas rdo rje me ltar 'bar bar bdag nyid bsam te/ dpal mchog tu/ sngon po 'bar ba'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /zhal gyi mche ba cung zad gzigs/ /zhal ni khro dang bcas pas bzhad/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung gis legs bzhugs/ /snyems bcas shas cher 'bar ba la/ /'od zer 'bar ba khrugs pa yi/ /rdo rje gsor bar mdzad la brtson/ /zhes te/ gdung pa can bsod cing tshar gcod pa dang bskrod pas khro bo/ rnam rtog mi phyed pas rdo rje/ nyon mongs bsreg pas me ltar 'bar ba'i don yin par rtse mor bshad do/ /rang khro me ltar 'bar ba bskyed pa 'di bu ston gyis 'chad do/

/bor bskyed pa de brtan par bya ba'i phyir byin gyis rlobs pa ni/ oṃ gh+rih+na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes te/ zungs shig rdo rje'i dam tshig ces pa ste/ /khro bo rnams kyi 'da' bar mi bya ba'i phyag rgya ni dam tshig ste zungs shig pa'o/ /rdo rje bsdams pa/ nang du bcings pa'i steng mthe bos mnan pa khro bo ti rin ti'i phyag rgyar bshad de/ rdo rje'i rigs thams cad bsdus pa'i phyag rgya zhes pa'i don yin gsungs/ 'di dang me ltar 'bar ba gcig yin te/ dpal mchog bstod 'grel du/ khro bo ti rin ti ri zhes bya ba rdo rje me ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i dam tshig gis phyag rgya'o zhes dang / de gnyis gcig tu yang yang bshad do/ /phyag rgya de gnas lngar gtug cing / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lar ka hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ zhes pa ste/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes pas te/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar rdo rje rtse lnga pa re bsam zhes rje btsun gsungs pa ltar du phyi ma'i 'grel par yang 'byung ngo / /kha cig rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba la gnas lngar khro bo'i rdo rje lte ba yan chad pa lnga bskyed zer yang snga ma'o gsungs so/ /go bgo ba ni/ oṃ truṃ zhes te/ rtse mor/ don kun rab tu bsgrub byed pa'i/ /yid gnyis go cha bzang po yin/ /zhes so/ /ko sa lar/ dar dkar po zheng du khru gang pa chur khru nyi shu rtsa lnga pa zhes bshad cing / rje btsun khru nyi shu gcig pa'o zhes gsungs/ kun snying ni khru nyi shu pa gsungs/ thal mo'i gshams gdabs cing / oṃ badz+ra tuṣ+ya ho rdo rje dges pa zhes so/ /'di dag la bla ma gnur pa dang / bla ma 'phags 'od sogs na smad lugs kun/ re/ dpa' bos dgra 'joms pa la/ dpa' bo'i rigs su skyes pa/ ma las gso nams tshang du phyin pa/ dpa' bor dbang bskur ba/ go cha bstan pa dang bcas bzhi tshang dgos pa ltar/ khro bo'i rigs su skyes pa/

sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs pa/ dbang bskur ba/ go cha gon pa dang bzhi tshang ba zhig bgegs dpung 'joms pa la dgos zhes gsungs so/ /des bdag bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ste/ gnas bsrung ba la/ sngar yod kyi bgegs tshar bcad pa dang / slar mi 'jug pa'i srung 'khor gnyis las/ dang po la bsnun bsreg bcing gsum gyi dang po ni/ lag pa g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying kar bzhag nas g.yas pas rdo rje gsor zhing bgegs la bsnun zhes rdo rje 'byung bar bshad la/ sems dpa' 'byung chen dang / don 'grub nag 'byams du/ rdo rje khu tshur gsor zhes 'byung ngo / /sngags ni oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la sogs te/ smad lugs pa sran phung la rdo rgyab pa 'dra ba yin gsungs/ bla ma 'phags 'od pa drang po ba na re/ brdung ba lta bu yin gsungs/ bsnun kyang ma shi mi 'bros pa'i bgegs rnams la rdo rje me'i sngags rgyas te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rdo rje me ltar 'bar ba/ ha na rgyob/ da ha sregs/ pa tsa tshos/ ma tha thul/ bhañtsa chom/ ra ṇā 'thab cig go /bsregs kyang me lha'i rigs kyi gdon/ /mes mi tshugs pa dag bcings pa'i phyir/ rdo rje bsdams pa bcings te/ mthe bong gshib pa ni spyan gyi phyag rgyas te/ badz+ra ne tri kyai rdo rje spyan ma/ ban+dha chings/ sarba bigh+nan bgegs thams cad do/ /ma rtags yod pas spyan mar bsgyur ba legs so/ /der rtse mor/ bgegs bcing ba ni ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje khu tshur 'bar ba dang / /rdo rje nyi ma rab 'bar dang / /rdo rje spyan gyi phyag rgya yis/ /bgegs bcing ba ni bstan par 'gyur/ /ces sogs/ gnyis pa bgegs shi nas yang bgegs su skyes te/ gnod srid pas/ de dag mi 'jug pa'i srung 'khor 'di la dar ma snying po sogs bod snga ma rnams/ rang me ltar 'bar bar gnas pas sngags rgya brjod cing / 'jigs byed can gyi lcags kyu/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phag rgod kyi mche ba/ gtsug tor gyi gtsug tor/

zhags pas zhags pa/ ba dan gyi ba dan/ dus kyi mche ba/ rtse mo'i ri rab/ thams cad sngon po g.yon brkyang gis gnas pa/ g.yas thugs khar sdigs mdzub/ g.yon rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /kha phyir bltas rang rang gi phyogs bltams pas srid pa'i rlung gis kyang mi mtho bar bsgom gsung ngo / /'di la bla ma rje btsun chen po khro bo spro ba pradz+nyā ba la ta'i gzhung 'chugs pa yin gyi/ sngags rgya'i nus pas rdo rje'i sas rdo rje'i ra ba bsgom pa yin gsungs shing / don 'di rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'grel par/ dkyil 'khor gyi mngon par 'dod pa'i sī cha kun nas rab tu rdo rje 'bar bas bar mtshams med par khyab pas bdag gir byas pa'i tshul lo/ /zhes pa dang mthun par snang ngo / /gnyan ston na re/ me ltar 'bar ba'i rnal 'byor gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje spros nas bsrung gsungs so/ /'di la bu ston rin po che mkhas mchog na re/ spyir lha cig phyag rgya zhig bcings te ting nge 'dzin tha dad kyis las tha dad 'grub pa'ang yod/ lha dang sngags tha dad ting nge 'dzin gcig gis tha dad 'grub pa'ang yod/ lha'i rnal 'byor gcig gis sngags dang phyag rgya tha dad kyi las tha dad 'grub pa'ang yod/ lha sngags phyag rgya thams cad tha dad kyis 'grub par gsungs pa rnams las/ 'dir phal cher lha sngags so sor mngon te/ 'on kyang brtag gsung ngo / /kho bo ni bla ma rje btsun gyis rjes su 'brangs so/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rgyud du/ rdo rje bsdams pa kha thur du bstan te/ brkyang pa sa la bzhag ste/ 'dir rdo rje'i sa gzhir 'gyur te/ de la sus kyang glags mi rnyed do zhes te/ oṃ badz+ra dri ḍo me bha wa rak+ṣa sarban swāhā/ ni rdo rje bstan pa bdag la kun tu bsrung ba mdzad do zhes zer ba'o/ /rtse mor swāhā zhes pa ci yin brjod/ sdig pa thams cad zhi byed cing / /dge ba'i tshogs ni 'phel bar byed/

/nyes par spyad pa 'phrog byed cing / /sdug bsngal thams cad 'joms pa'i mchog /ces so/ /'byung bar/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis la mgar me'i 'khor lo bzhin du bskor te mgo bo'i steng mdzub mo lcags kyu'i tshul du bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed spyan gyi phyag rgya'o zhes te/ hu lu ni mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud du zhugs shig pa'o zhes dang / zla grags kyis ring shing ring pa ces dang / shan+ti pas kye ma 'ong zhes bshad do/ /gtsug dgur/ rdo rje thal mo'i mthe mong gnyis brkyangs la mdzub mo gnyis mche ba ltar byas pa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis phyag rgya'o zhes te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ kyai rdo rje gnod yin zhes 'bod pa'o/ /gtsug dgur/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel la/ mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo sbyar ba bzlog nas spyi bor bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o zhes te/ oṃ druṃ ban+dha haṃ zhes te/ druṃ ni/ sa bon no/ /ban+dha chings/ haṃ bsrung ba'o/ /gtsug dgur/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mkhrig ma mdud pa byas pa ni rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgya'o zhes te/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra pa sha hrīḥzhes te/ rgya dper oṃ yod/ hūm̐ med do/ /bstod 'grel du oṃ med hūm̐ yod de/ rdo rje 'byung ba bod dpe ru oṃ dang hūm̐ gnyis ka yod do/ /kyai rdo rje zhags pa zhes bod pa'o/ /hri ni gsal bar gyis shig pa'o/ /gtsug dgur/ rdo rje bsdam pa las mthe bong g.yon pa'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung du byas pa las mdzub mo gnyis gshibs te phye la/ mthe chung ba dan ltar byas pa ni/ rdo rje ba dan gyi rgya'o/ /zhes te/ oṃ badz+ra pa taṅke kyai rdo rje ba dan ces bod pa'o/ /pa taṅke ba dan can no/ /ni ra ṭa nges par mchod ces pa'o/ /gtsug dgur rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya snying gar bstan te/ bzhag pa'i dus kyi phyag rgya'o/

/zhes te/ hri son no/ /badz+ra ka li ni kyai rdo rje dus can nag mo zhes bod pa'o/ ruṭa zhes 'byung ste/ chod cig go /maṭa chom zhes/ yang ruṭa dga' ba dang bral ba'o/ /zhes rab zhi bshes gnyen 'chad do/ /ruṭa 'jigs par gyis zhes lan gnyer 'byung ltar na/ ru dzo 'jigs pa la'o zhes pa'i dbyings dang mthun no gsungs ngo / /gtsug dgur/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi ri ba 'degs pa'i tshul du byed pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgya'o zhes te/ oṃ badz+ra shi kha re/ rdo rje rtse mo zhes bod pa'o/ /ru ṭa sogs sngar bzhin no/ /'byung bar/ rdo rje khro gnyer gnyis bcings la/ mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te/ mthe'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel ba/ khams gsum rnam rgyal zhes pa'i mdzub mo gnyis sdigs mdzub tu bsgreng ba ni/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya'o zhes dang / de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis rdo rjer byas pa ni/ rdo rje las kyi phyag rgya'o zhes pa ltar byas te/ oṃ badz+ra karma zhes te/ rdo rje las zhes bod pa'o/ /don grub nag 'byam sogs nas/ hūm̐ badz+ra karma zhes pa byung gsung ngo / /sngar bshad pa'i hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ hūm̐ zhes nang du ra ba bya/ rdo rje kun bzang sbyin sreg tu/ bsdams pa bcings la/ badz+ra ban+dha ni bsdams pa/ baṃ ni chings shig pa'o/ /'dis steng du rdo rje dra ba ste ra ba'i steng du gur sbyin par bya'o/ /'byung ba'i 'grel par/ steng g.yog kyi gzeb bri'o/ /zhes so/ /pañtsa raṃ zhes pa gur dang 'dra ba gnyis ka la 'jug go /don grub nag 'byam du 'di rdo rje'i bla rer bsgyur ba yod de ma dag go /a bha ya ni/ ra ba'i steng du mda'i dra ba la bzhed do/ /rdo rje las kyi sngags rgyas phyi rol nas sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra bas bskor/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi sngags rgyas sngar gyi ra ba'i nang du ra ba byas pas phyogs thams cad la ra ba gsum rim/ steng dang shar la bzhi rim/

'og la rdo rje'i sa gzhi rkyang pa/ dbyibs zlum pa yin te/ gtsug dgu las/ kun nas yongs su zlum por ni/ /ra ba dra ba byas nas kyang / /zhes rje btsun gsungs/ rgya khyon blos khyud tshad sgom mo/ /'di la paṇ+ḍi ta kha cig phyi'i ra ba ni gru bzhi lham pa/ stong gsum dang mnyam pa/ nang gi ra ba ni kun nas zlum po 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i tshad du gyur pa'o zer te/ shes byed btsal lo/ /srung 'khor ni phal che rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel/ de yang sa la bgegs 'byung ba mang ste/ lha ma yin dang klu ma rung pa dang / tha na rkang gi 'gro ba'i srin bus kyang gnod pa'i phyir/ sngon la 'og 'chings/ steng na bdud sdig can gyi dpungs gnas pa dang / dri za dang lha'i gdon shar du gnas shing gnod pas steng dang shar lan gnyis 'ching / sprin dang ser ba dang / char ches pa klus byed cing klu rnams nub na gnas pas nub 'ching / gtor ma 'dod pa la sogs pa'i phyir gnod sbyin dag bar du gcod pas byang 'ching / lho na gshin rje rnams gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i lung gis 'jug la/ de ni dge ba la bar chad mi byed pas 'jug tu bstan zer la/ dar ma snying po na re/ shar nas slob ma lan gnyis 'jug cing slob dpon yang 'jug la/ steng nas tshangs pa lha'i bdud stobs che ba'i phyir de lan gnyis bcings shing / rim pas mi 'ching ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi thig dang sgo bstun pa'o zer/ klan na re/ mgon po kun snang gi rgyud rang du/ tshangs pa brgya byin stobs che bas/ /shar dang steng ni lan gnyis bcings/ /zhes pa ltar yin zer yang / gtsug dgur/ kun gyi mjug tu 'og bcing bar bzhed pa dang / rtse mor phyogs rim bzhin bcings pas mtha' cig tu ma nges par snang ngo / /'dir mnga' stod lugs pa rnams/ ris zla 'od sogs kyis/ khro bo bstod/ bgegs la bka' bsgo/ hūm̐ bzhis bsrung / yig brgyas brtan par/

sems dpa' bzhis bsrung ba rnams kyis kha bskang ngo / /'dir khro bo smad lugs pa rnams/ bstod pa sogs ma bshad cing mi dgos la/ byed na go bgos pa'i rjes bsnun bsreg bcings gsum gyi gong du/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi dkyil chog las bshad pas go bar bya'o/ /de lta min na sngar yod kyi bgegs bcom zhing / phyin chad mi 'jug pa'i srung 'khor byas rjes su/ khro bo spyan drangs pa la dgos pa med gsungs kyang / ra ba rnams bsrung ba la spyan drangs pa mi 'gal te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bshad pa bzhin no/ /yig brgya dang sems dpa' bzhi'i bsrung ba kun med kyang chog pa 'dra'o/ /'di tsam gyi spros pa mi dgos te/ rgyud phyi mar/ rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan tsam zhig /lan cig tsam yang brjod gyur na/ /'di ni bsrung ba rtag chen po/ /skad cig gis ni dngos grub thob/ /ces badz+ra satwa zhes brjod pa tsam gyis chog par bshad pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhe na skyon med de/ de nas nang la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i dbang du byas la/ 'di dkyil 'khor chen po slob ma dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas gsung ngo / /'dir khro bo spyan gyi tshigs bcad rnams sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms cho ga na yod cing / smṛ ti'i gsang ldan 'grel par yang yod do/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog tu/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang / hūm̐ bzhis snying kha dang / dpral ba dang / lkog ma dang / spyi bor bdag nyid byin gyis rlabs par bya'o zhes te/ sgron gsal du/ sum+bha sod cig ni sum+bha nges par thul cig hūm̐ de gsal bar byed do/ /grih+na gnod byed 'bros pa rnams zungs shig grih+na pa ya gnyis/ gnod byed kyi 'khor rnams kyang zungs shig go /hūm̐ gnyis ni 'dzin par bskul ba'o/ /a na ya ho/ bha ga wan/ rdo rje zhags pas chings/ rdo rje lcags kyus snying phug la khug gcig go /hūm̐ phaṭ/

gsod pa la bskul ba'o zhes bshad do/ /de nas 'byung ba nas bshad pa'i sems dpa' bzhi'i bsrung ba ste go sla'o/ /de nas gtsug dgu nas yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o zhes pa ltar yi ge brgya pas brtan par brjod nas dril bu dkrol te/ 'di rnams bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag len las kha tshar ba yin no zhes rje btsun gsung ngo / /'dir gzugs brnyan sbyor ba snga rabs pa phal ches rang nyid rdor sems su bskyed de bsgoms kyang / rdo rje 'byung ba dang mkhas pa dag gsung bas 'dir bsgom pa 'thad de/ sbyong rgyud las/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du byin gyis brlabs te/ hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang / a zhes bya ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de nyid byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo gnyis ka la/ /a la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu drug kun du gang zhing 'phros par bya ste/ mthe bong gnyis la oṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūm̐ zhes bya ba bzhag gung mo gnyis la traṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ srin lag gnyis la hri zhes bya ba bzhag mthe chung gnyis la a zhes bya ba bzhag de ltar yi ge rnams yin par mos pa bskyed de zhes so/ /me long ltar dngas pa'i nang du rigs lnga yab yum gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bar bsgom pa'o/ /thal mo khong stong du sbyar te/ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tā/ sarba dharmā/ chos kun phan tshun rjes su song ba zhes bya'o/ /de nyid snang chen du/ sor mo thams cad kyi tshig gsum pa phan tshun bsnol ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo ste zhes pa ltar sbyar ba/ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma/ badz+ra a dza li zhes te/ chos thams cad phan tshun rjes su zhugs pa'i thal mo zhes so/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bcas la/ a d+yan ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā/ badz+ra ban+dha zhes chos thams cad phan tshun rjes su zhugs pa'i rdo rje bsdams pa zhes te/ 'di gsum gyi drod rtse mo bzod pa'i ye shes mtshon ces slob dpon kun snying gsung ngo / bu ston dmangs so/

badz+ra ban+dha traṭa ni/ badz+ra ni/ 'od gsal stong nyid/ ban dha 'ching ba/ traṭa bral bar gyis zhes pa ste/ snying gar sgra dang bcas pa lan gsum bkrol bar bya ste/ lan gsum bkral ba'i dgos pa kun snying khams gsum gyi bag chags bral ba gyis zhes pa dang / shes rab grub/ dus gsum gyi sdig pa bral bar bzhed/ shākya bshes gnyen/ go che dang lcags pa dang sha bral bar bzhed/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ sgo gsum gyi sdig pa bral bar bzhed mod/ gang la sbyar kyang rung bar nges/ /de nas phyag rgya 'grub pa'i don gyi cho ga ni/ badz+ra a be sha rdo rje 'bebs pa zhes te/ rdo rje bsdams pa bcings pa'i srin lag gi rtsa bar mthe bo btsugs te snying kar bskyed cing / a aḥzhes bya bas rang gi snying gi zla ba la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas dang po'i rdo rje kha dog dmar po 'bar ba byung ste rang gi snying gar zhugs nas lus kun du gang bar bsam par bya'o/ /de babs pas sgrub pa po gang 'dod pa rdzogs par bya'o/ /de babs pas sgrub pa po/ ye shes babs pa de brtan par byed pa de tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dri ḍo me bha wa ni/ bdag la rdo rje brtan par mdzod/ sha shwa to me bha wa ni/ bdag la brtan par mdzod/ hri da ya me a ti tiṣ+ṭha ni/ bdag gi snying la lhag par mnos shig sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha ni bdag la dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ hūm̐ ni bzhugs pa'i sa bon/ ha bzhi ni ye shes bzhi/ ho ni mnyes shing dbang du byed pa'o/ /'di la smad lugs pa yi ge brgya brgya phyed zer ro/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi dkyil chog tu/ hūm̐ gi gong du sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+ra shrī yaṃ ku ru zhes bsnan te/ de ltar na brgya phyed yod do/ /badz+ra muṣ+ṭi ni rdo rje khu tshur muṣ+ṭi baṃ zhes pas sgrol bar bla ma rnams bzhed kyang sngags don mi mthun par snang ngo / /dgos pa ni/ de nyid 'dus par/ rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings la/

/phyag rgya thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar phyag rgya thams cad 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /'dir ltung ba slong ba'i phyag rgya dang / ngan 'gro 'gugs pa dang / sdig pa bsreg pa sogs rdo rje 'byung bar yod do/ /de dag byas pas phyag rgya thams cad 'grub pa dang / bskal pa grangs med gsum gyi nges par 'byung ba'i byang sems srid pa tha ma pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro zhes kun snying gis bshad do/ /'dir a pe shas ye shes 'bebs pa'i yun ni rgyud dus su bskyed pa'i rdo rje 'bebs pa kun smon gsungs pa ltar legs so/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor la dpa' bo gnyis pa dang / dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sbyong rgyud du/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug ste/ /thams cad zos te kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rjer ldan la smod ci dgos/ /zhes te/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'jug pa po rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas rdo rje 'dir hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pas bya ba'i rdo rje dkar po mi bya ste/ 'dir spyan gyi rdo rje yin la/ de dang po'i rdo rje dmar po yin pas zer ba yang yin pas ma nges so/ /sems dpar/ sprul pa ye shes pa ma bcug bsod dbang 'jug go sgom gsung ngo / /de nas rang rdor sems su bsgom la/ shāka thub kyi skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ thal mo sbyar ba dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes sgrib pa thams cad zungs zhes pa'o/ /mnyam par bzhag pa dpral bar ni/ /phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo sbyar/ /sangs rgyas bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi phyag rgyar bshad/ /ces so/ /yang thal mo khong stong mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pa sgrib pa thams cad bral bar gyis ces pa'o/ /de nyid du/ rnal 'byor rig pas mgrin phyogs su/ /thal mo snyim pa sbyar ba ni/

/rtag tu pad+ma'i rang nyid kyi/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /ces so/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis dang / mtha' bzhi bsgreng ba snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ sgrib pa thams cad chod chod ces pa'o/ /de nyid du/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /snying gar gung mo mtha' sbyar ba/ /rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /dam tshig thams cad 'dzin pa'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /de dag gi sgo gsum gyis sgrib pa sbyangs na/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ sogs kyis dbang len pa go sla zhing / bdag kun rig tu bskyed nas/ spyi bor rnam snang dang / dpral bar mi bskyod pa sgom/ kun dga' smon lam gsungs ba legs so/ /tshangs pa sprul lung pa bu ston 'od zer/ chen sogs ni mkhas pa mang pos mdzad kyang da lta mi dgos par sems so/ /gzhan phan 'od zer du/ mchod bstod tshar nas bzlas pa mdzad bu ston kun smon kyang / da lta phal cher 'dir bzlas pa mdzad do/ /mchod pa 'bul ba kun la bsang sbyangs sngon du 'gro ba byed dgos te/ dpung bzang du su/ khrus byed pa na g.yo zhing 'gul ba dri chab la dri za/ bdug spos la nag po lus can/ mar me la gtsug phud cig pa/ me tog la me tog cher rgyas/ lha bshos la gtsug gtor gdugs dkar nas bshad pa'i zas su gtor ma za ba sogs mchod pa la gnas nas sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs yod par rig pa mchog tu'ang bshad pas/ de rnams bskrad pa'i phyir mchod pa de dag la lus kyis rdo rje gnod sbyin bzlas pa'i spos chu 'thor/ ngag tu badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes brjod/ yid kyis rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i khro bo'i tshogs kyi bgegs bskrad par bsam/ rdo rje me'i sngags dang phyag rgyas tha mal pa'i dngos po ngan pa rnams bsregs nas gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par bskyed/

'dis bsregs pa'i sbyang ba ltar ma dag pa sbyangs pa'o/ /'di la rje btsun gyis phyi'i bgegs kyis mi tshugs pa'i ched yin gsungs/ gnyan na re/ dngos por zhen pa'i rnam rtog bsregs pa yin gsung ngo / /oṃ swā bhā wa shud+dha sogs sam/ sarbā ka ri zhes pas kun snying dang bu ston mthun no/ /rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i stong par sgom zhes a wa ta rar bshad do/ /rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i 'grel par 'byung ba ltar/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ oṃ/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sa bon yin pas de la dgos 'dod 'byung ba'o/ /las skyes pa'i mchod rdzas pa'i mchod rdzas sprul te/ mig yor ltar mngon par zhen pa med par spyan drangs te sgyu ma'i skyes bu bzhin du spyad par bya'o zhes gsung ngo / /rang rang gi sngags kyis ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ phyag rgya de bstan par byed de/ skad cig tsam min par byed do/ /rdo rje 'byung bar/ phyag lnga gcig tu sdom pa'i mchod pa nyi shu dang / 'og las rgyal chog tu/ me tog dang / dri dang / bdug pa dang / lha bshos dang / snang gsal dang / mchod yon dang drug po rim pa 'di ltar bshad/ rol mo ni ma bshad kyang / phyag len la kha bskong ba mdzad cing / ar+ghaṃ sogs spyi'i mchod pa dang / sgo bstun nas 'jig rten khams ni ma 'di bla ma rje btsun gyis bsdus la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma ni rkyang pa chos blos mdzad do/ /zhes bla ma'i zhal las thos so/ /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ zhes pa dang / sarba ta thā ga ta sogs sla la/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis rnam pa mchod rdzas/ ngo bo lha rdzas/ dngas shing thogs med du bskyed de/ 'dir chu gcig bde mchog sogs chu gnyis/ 'khor chen nas chu gsum/ kyai rdor chu bzhi bshad de/ ar+ghaṃ ni mchod yon dang rin gyis nyos pa gnyis la 'jug kyang /

'di snga ma/ pu dza ni mchod pa ste/ bsnyen bkur/ me gha ni sprin te tshogs/ sa mu dra rgya mtsho ste grangs las 'das par ston no/ /shākya bshes gnyen zer/ s+pha ra ṇa 'phro ba ste/ dpag tu med pa spro ba/ sa ma ya ni/ a ma sho kar/ mna' dang / kun spyod/ dus/ grub mtha'/ yang dag rig pa/ nyes rgyu/ mi dge ba/ sngon gyi las rnams la 'jug par bshad kyang / 'dir dam tshig ste/ mchod pa'i sprin da pungs spro ba'i tshul las mi 'da'o/ /de ltar na mchod yon sogs bshams la phyi rol yo byad kyi mchod pa/ sngar brjod pas rigs sngags 'das pa'i mchod pa/ phyag bcing ba phyag rgya'i mchod pa/ lha sgom pa rnal 'byor sgom pa'i mchod pa/ des rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa bsgrub pa'i mchod pa ste/ re re la'ang lnga lnga tshang ba rtse mo las/ mchod pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ /rigs lnga mngon par bzlas brjod dang / /phyag rgya bcing ba lhur len dang / /rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i mchod pa dang / /sgrub pa rang gi mchod pa dang / /zhes so/ /'di dag la jo bo rje na re/ phar phyin pa'i lugs kyi sngags dang phyag rgya med par don dam par rang bzhin med par/ kun rdzob rgyu ma'i rang bzhin du bsam mo/ /kra yī lugs kyi/ so so'i rnam pa dang 'dra ba las/ don lha'i rang bzhin du 'dod/ rnal 'byor brgyud pa/ mchod pa'i lha mo so so'i phyag mtshan gyi don dang 'dra ba'i me tog la sogs pa'i rnam par bskyed/ rnal 'byor chen po/ mchod pa rnams lha mor bskyed gsung ngo / /'di la dpyad rgyu yod do/ /gtsug dgur/ thams cad la lce brgya pa'i kha du mas bstod pa nye bar sbyor bar mos te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas bstod par bya'o/ /zhes te/ sbyong rgyud las gsungs pa'i/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /sogs kyi bstod de/ 'di'i 'bru non bla ma rje btsun pas mdzad pa'i logs su yod zer te brtag par bya'o/ /bstod pa 'di'i bstod pa'i phan yon ni/

/sbyong rgyud du/ gang gis 'di bris bklags gyur te/ /rtag tu de don 'chang byed dam/ /dran nam nyan par byed kyang rung / /phyag na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /ces gsungs so/ /dpa' bo gcig pa'o/ /bdag gi rnal 'byor yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom na 'og nas 'chad pa ltar bsgom mo/ /de nas skabs su babs pa'i bum pa'i bzlas pa ni/ bum pa rgyas par ni/ mchod pa'i bum pa bcu drug dbang bskur ba'i bum pa lnga/ rnam rgyal dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis dgos te/ de yang sbyong rgyud du/ gser las byas pa'i bya rnams ni/ /brgyad dam bcu drug lhag kyang rung / /zhes mchod pa'i bum pa dang / dbang bskur rin chen chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa lnga ni bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas dbang gi lnga/ rnam rgyal bum pa dri yi chus/ /rab tu bkang ste bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas rnam rgyal la/ de dag kyang 'khor lo'i rgyud du/ nag po ra ri med pa yi/ /bum pa lto che bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan ldan par/ /snying po ldan pa'i sman sogs gzhug /mgrin par ras bzang dag gis bkris/ /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcag ma yang / /dri dang ldan pa'i kha rgyan can/ /zhes pa ltar gyi don/ rdo rje 'byung bar/ rin po che 'am sa las byas pa rtsa ba nag po med pa sogs 'byung ba'i rtsa ba dang nag po med pa ste zhabs stegs med pa'o/ /'bras sa lu'am/ sa dkar gyis byug bgegs bskrad gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ rin chen lnga ni/ byu ru/ gser/ dung / dngul/ mu tig pad+ma mu men ra dga'am/ sangs rgyas lnga thob pa'i ched do/ /sman lnga ni/ ha sti stag tsher/ kan dha ka ri/ tsher ma byed pa/ ha sa de wa ba/ lha dang bcas pa/ daṇ+ḍod dpal la la/ dbyug pa'i at+pal/ shwe ta a pa ra dzi ta/ gzhan gyi mi thub pa dkar ba'o/ /de dag nyon mongs pa dug lnga sel ba'i ched do/ /'bru lnga ni/ 'bras/ nas/ gro/ til/ sran ma ste/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i ye shes skye ba'i sa bon gyi don du'o/

/'di dag gsang ba spyi rgyud na yod pa'i/ gtsug dgur/ snying po lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /ces pa'i don chu'i snying po lan tshwa me tog snying po sbrang rtsi/ shing thog gi snying po ka ra/ rtsi thog gi snying po mar/ 'bru'i snying po til mar zhes bla ma gsung ngo / /des na snying po lnga ni gzhung phal cher las mi 'byung ngo / /dri lnga po 'di/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud nas bshad do/ /bum pa thams cad la sman lnga sogs bzhug par ni 'dra la/ mchod pa'i bum pa la mtshan ma med/ rnam rgyal bum pa la rigs kyi mtshan ma tshang bar dgod/ dbang gi bum pa re re la 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshan pa'o/ /mgul par ras dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pas/ yal 'dab dang ldan pas shing gi kha rgyan/ rnam rgyal dbus dang / dbang gi bum pa phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar bkod/ mchod pa'i bum pa rnams khor yug tu bkod/ ma 'byor na mchod pa'i bum pa khams phor la sogs pa'i mchod yon gyi snod la btub rje btsun gsung / rnam rgyal dang dbang gi lnga'am/ de ma 'byor na rnam rgyal cig pu'o/ /de yin te/ lha gnas bum pa gang yin pa/ /rnam rgyal bum pa 'di la rdzogs/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /sbyong rgyud nas las bum ma bshad kyang / kun snying gis/ rdo rje gnod dang ldan pas/ bum pa gang ba bzhag par byed/ /ces dang / rdo rje 'byung bar yang las bum la sna tshogs rdo rje'i mche ba gdags gsung ngo / /rnam rgyal du rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed par bshad pa'ang yod pa las bum dang thun mong ba byas te/ rnam rgyal du rdor sems bskyed na/ de g.yon du gnod sbyin bskyed de/ bum pa gnyis yod na cig tu rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed/ rnam rgyal du dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa'am/ rdor sems bskyed pa'am/ lha ma bskyed kyang rung / rje btsun gsung / rnam rgyal gyi steng du/ dung phor ram/ nya phyis sogs mchod yon gyi snod du dri bzang blug

rdo rje rtse lnga pa la/ me tog gi phreng ba btags pa'i lcug ma nas bzung ste/ sbyong rgyud du/ snga ma bzhin du bum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /zhes pas rtsa rig dang / lha so so'i snying po bzlas te/ rjes su lha rnams zhu ba'i chur bsam/ rje btsun gsung ngo / /rdo rje rtse mor/ badz+ra u da ka stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas gsungs shing / chu de bdud rtsir 'gyur bar bshad do/ /rab gnas yin na khrus kyi sngags rnams bzlas so/ /gzhan rnams sla'o/ /de ni rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha bskyed pa la/ sngon ri rab kyi ste du dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur ba ltar/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du bya ba'i phyir/ rgyud dag las 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang bcas pa gsungs la/ shin tu bsdus pa/ cung zad bsdus pa/ 'bring po/ shin tu rgyas pa'i lugs rnams las/ sbyong rgyud ltar na shas mtshon te/ shu n+yā tas stong par sgom/ 'byung bar a ka ras stong par sgom pa'i ngang las/ sbyong rgyud ltar na/ oṃ bha las skad cig gi 'byung ba rim brtsegs gzhal yas khang dang bcas bskyed de/ bh+ruṃ yig snod dang rnam snang dang gzhal yas khang gi sa bon yin par der bskyed de/ bha nibh+ruṃ mtshan pa'o/ /'di ni shin tu bsdus nas bskyed pa'i lugs so/ /cung zad bsdus pa ni/ thams cad gsang ba/ 'gro 'dul rnams las/ yaṃ baṃ laṃ baṃ las bskyed do/ /'bring ni mnyam rjes kyi sa bon mtshon pa'i phyir/ hūm̐ gnyis kyi bar la sa bon bcug pa ste/ hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho/ hūm̐ la hūm̐ las gser gyi sa gzhi/ hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ las rgya mtsho chen po/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ las ri rab shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma ra ga byang gser las grub pa bskyed do/ /de yang gtsug dgu'i gzhung du/ rlung dang chu gnyis dbus su ni/

/gser gyi sa gzhi rnams bsgom la/ /suṃ gyi sa bon las byung ba'/ི /ri rab chen po bsam par bya/ /khams gsum rgyal gyi dkyil chog tu'ang / /'di ltar bshad pa/ 'di'i rgya gzhung mang por yang chu dang sa bshad la/ me ma bshad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan bla ma dag mkha' la rlung brten de la chu'i phung po brten/ sogs phyi rol gyi snod chags pa dang sgo bstun pas/ rnal 'byor rgyud man la me mi 'byung zhing / rnal 'byor chen por nang lus la sbyor bas/ me bshad pa yin gsung ngo / /gtsug dgu'i rgyud du ni/ yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ baṃ las chu/ kaṃ las gser gyi sa gzhi zhes dang / yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud du yang / de'i dbus su gzi brjid che/ /zhes me bshad pa'ang snang ngo / /shin tu rgyas pa ni/ dpal mchog smad 'grel dang / don 'grub nag 'byam du/ mig g.yas g.yon du ma dang ṭa dgod/ hūm̐ las mig 'bras bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bas bltas pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje 'bar ba rdo rje'i lte ba la yi ge wa'i sa bon dang bcas pa 'od zer 'bar ba 'khrugs/ 'od zer des sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad thal bar bsregs de nas stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i yi ge khaṃ dkar po las/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'o ma lta bu babs pas zhing bsregs pa rnams bkrus/ rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i rgya mtshor gyur pa'i dbus su raṃ yig byung / des skol ba las pad+ma 'dab ma bye ba can byung / pad+ma'i rtsa bar pra yig ser po las gser gyis rus sbal tshad gzhal du med pa ni pad+ma'i rten gzhir gyur pa/ pad+ma'i lte bar pra yig dang khaṃ yig bsam zhing / de nas pad+ma dang yi ge pra dang / khaṃ yig rnams gcig tu gyur pa las/ hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ las ri rab gru bzhi pa sogs bshad do/ /'dir ni sbyong rgyud las gsungs pa gtso bor bzung zhing rje btsun rin po che dang / mkhas pa kun smon gyis kyang bshad do/

/bsod dbang gis ri rab chad do/ /yang rgyas 'bring du byed na ni/ rdo rje 'byung ba nas bshad pa'i/ oṃ badz+ra ḍi ḍo me bha wa sogs dang rdo rje bsdams pa brkyangs pa sa la reg pa'i phyag rgyas sa gzhi sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje rgyu'i las rgya dang bh+rūm̐ yig dkar po las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang pa ste/ sbyong rgyud du/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa dang / /them skas bzhi yi phreng ba dang / /seṅge ba glang rnams kyis brgyan/ /ces pa ltar bsgom zhing / dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra ba la/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs bcu drug /ces sogs rgyas par 'byung ste/ gzhal yas khang sgo nyis rim rta babs dang bcas pa'o zhes gsungs/ rje btsun ni/ sbyong rgyal gyi dgongs pa sgo rkyang yin te/ byang sems bcu drug sogs mang po bshad nas/ de'i rjes la sgo ba ma bshad pa sogs gsung ngo / /de'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa ni dngos su gsungs kyang / 'di kha dog ser por chag los bshad cing / phyogs mdog gam/ kha cig sngon po zer te/ shes byed btsal dgos so/ /'khor lo'i lte bar le tshe dgu'i dbus su la sogs par seṅge la sogs pa'i gdan ste/ de'ang rgyas par na/ dbus su/ a sing aḥ las so so'i gdan/ hūm̐ ga hūm̐ las glang po che/ tra bā tra/ hri māṃ hri/ a gaṃ a lasamakha' lding gi gdan te/ rim pa bzhin/ sing ha/ ga dzo bī dza/ ma pu ra/ ga ru ḍa rnams de dag gi ming yin zhing / ming yig dang po las bskyed pa'o/ /de dag gi steng du pad+ma yod de/ smad 'grel du/ seṅge dang pad+ma'i gdan zhes bshad pas/ klan pad+ma med par 'dod pa'ang de khegs so/ gtsug dgur/ lte bar seṅge'i khri'o/ /de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes dang / 'byung bar/ seṅge'i gdan sogs la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yi ge a las skyes pa zhes bshad do/

/rtse mor rnam par snang mdzad seṅge'i gdan/ mi bskyod pa ni glang chen chibs/ /rin chen dbang ni rta la bzhon/ /rma bya'i khri la tshe dpag med/ /don 'grub mkha' lding dbang por bzhugs/ /zhes dang / gnyis med rdo rjes mtshan brjod sgrub thabs su/ dbus su seṅge gti mug bdag /shar du glang chen zhe sdang bdag /lhor ni rta ste nga rgyal bdag /nub tu rma bya chags pa'i bdag /byang du shang shang phrag dog ste/ /lnga'i bdag nyid bcom pa'i gdan/ /zhes so/ /lha'i gnas gzhan rnams thams cad du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan zhes rje btsun gsung ba ltar/ gzhan las kyang 'byung bas de ltar bsam nas brten pa lha bskyed pa la gsum yod pa'i dang po bsdus pa ni/ thams cad sa bon tsam la bskyed pa ste/ oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hriḥ.aḥ las rigs lnga laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ las yum bzhi/ hūm̐ dzaḥsogs bcu drug la sems dpa' bcu drug bskyed cing / sgom pa'i bar so bdun po sa bon la bskyed pa 'di mkhas pa ldong sogs bzhed cing / rigs lnga yum bzhi sa bon las bskyed par/ a bha yas byang chub gzhung lam las kyang bshad de 'di la mi rigs pa med do/ /gnyis pa 'bring du bskyed na/ snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa ste/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pas dbus su kun rig sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa/ zhal bzhi ka dkar po yin te/ sbyong rgyud/ dung dang kuñtsa zla 'dra ba zhes so/ /shākya bshes gnyen/ mi bzhi rgyab sprod ltar 'dod pa mi rigs te/ de na phyag brgyad yong bar rigs pa las/ phyag gnyis par dngos su bshad pas so/ /oṃ sarba bid hūm̐ gis sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar la cung zad dmar ba gsungs phyogs bzhi'i rigs bzhi po mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams rgyu yin pa la sku mdog 'di ltar gyur pa ni/ rigs re re'ang lnga lngar phye ste/ sbyong rgyal rnam snang gi lugs mi bskyod pa/

rgyal mchog rin chen rin 'byung gi /mi bskyod pa shākya ri dbang / rin 'byung 'od dpag med/ des na 'di ni bla ma'i man ngag go /yang / sbyong rgyud du/ de'i spyan sngar ngan song kun/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal po bri bar bya/ /phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin du bsgom/ /zla ba rgyas dang pad+ma'i sbyongs rgyal mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo yin la/ mi bskyod pa sngon por 'ong ba'i nges pa med/ zla bzang thig ler/ rtag pa'i sku ni ser po ste/ /mi bskyod rdo rje dkar po yin/ /nam mkha'i snying po mthing kha che/ /tshe dpag med pa'i pad+mo dmar/ /sbyong rgyal kha dog rgya chen mchog /sogs bshad pa ltar/ mdog /ces so/ /oṃ sarba bid phaṭ kyis rgyal mchog /bid as shākya ri dbang / bid tras rin chen me tog bskyed do/ /mtshams su lha mo bzhi ni/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa nis spyan ma/ oṃ badz+ra ma ma kis/ ma ma ki sngon mo/ oṃ badz+ra paṇ+ḍi ri de hi de hi sid+dhi bo dhi lo ke ta riṃ pa swāhās gos dkar mo/ /oṃ badz+ra tā re tut+ta re tu re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swoṃ swāhās sgrol ma rnams bskyed do/ /de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i rtsibs su/ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dang / de bzhin du rim pa bzhin/ badz+ra satwa dza swa spru lung pa dang / bsod dbang gis sbyar te/ sbyong rgyud du/ sa bcu drug pa bcu drug dza bcu drug twa bcu drug 'byung ba'i don yin pas shin tu legs pas de kho na ltar bya ste 'di bzhag nas rtsa rgyud kyi ra dza dza sogs byed pa mtshal rang la byas nas btsag gzhan la 'tshol ba bzhin no/ sgeg sogs brgyad dang sgo ba rnams kyang rang rang gi snying pos bskyed do/ /de dag kyang sbyong rgyud du/ rgyan rnams kun gyis legs rdzogs pa/ /rgyal mchog skyes bu gang las bri/ /rgyab tu shākya ri dbang po/ /gtso bo thub pa bri bar bya/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyogs char ni/

/rgyal mchog rin chen me tog gnyis/ /lo tsā na dang ma ma kī/ /de bzhin dkar mo sgrol ma rnams/ /rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma bzhin/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu bri/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' mchog /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /go rim bzhin du bri bar bya/ /mkhas pas la se la sogs pa/ /mchod pa'i grwa yi phyogs su bri/ /sgo yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /sgo ba bzhi po bri bar bya/ /rta babs khyams ni thams cad du/ /byams pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /nyan thos rgyal ba thams cad dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal gtso bo rnams/ /khro bo sngags pa pho nya sogs/ /bri bya yang ni ming yang rung / /zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung la/ 'dir gtso bo dang / sbyong rgyal dkar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can du bshad la gzhan rnams kyi sku mdog dang phyag rgya'i gsal kha ma byung bas/ jo bo rje'i bzhed pas/ rtsa ba'i lha so bdud po thams cad dkar po mnyam gzhag byas par bzhed la/ sku+ur pa ye shes rgyal mtshan ni/ /rigs bzhi sbyong rgyal dang 'dra bar bzhed/ yang la la phyag rgya sbyong rgyal dang 'dra ba la/ rgyal mchog sngon po rin chen 'dzin/ shākya dmar ser pad+ma 'dzin/ me tog ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin par bzhed mod/ rje btsun gyi sems dpa' bcu drug sogs sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams kun dga' snying po'i gzhung dang mthun par mdzad pas yid ches pa'i gnas yin no/ /'dir gtso bo zhal bzhi ni/ byang chub kyi sems dang / sbyin pa dang / shes rab dang / brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pa sogs pa'o/ /zhes de nyid snang bar bshad do/ /kha cig zhal mtha' yas pa yin zhe na/ rtsa rgyud du rnam snang zhal bzhi par bri'o zhes pa ltar bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i lha so bdun las mi nyung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ khyad par de dag gi byed las/ zhar la nang gi sgo ba bzhi la dpyad pa rnams las dang po ni/

ci'i phyir rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo bsgyur ba dang tshul mtshungs zhe na/ rnam par snang mdzad ni 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yin te/ rtse mor/ chos 'dzin rgyal po chen po ste/ /rnam par snang mdzad khyab bdag che/ /zhes so/ mi bskyod pa sogs bzhi/ rgyal po rang bzhin pa lta bu yin te/ rtse mor/ rgyal po bzhi ni phyogs bzhi ru/ /zhes so/ /byang sems bcu drug ni/ de rnams kyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras rgyal bu yin te/ de bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /'jigs pa mi mnga' sems dpa' bzhi/ /mgon po yi ni thugs las byung / /lha dum bu dang po'i sprul bshad kyi skabs su/ spyan sogs yum bzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhis sprul nas gtso bo la phul/ de'i lan du rnam snang gi nang sgeg bzhi sprul nas de bzhin gshegs pa la gnang / yang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhis phyi sgeg bzhi sprul nas rnam snang la phul bar bshad/ mo bzhi ni/ rgyal po'i btsan mo lta bu ste/ /rgyal mo pha rol phyin bzhi ni/ /rdo rje pha rol phyin pa mchog /ces dang / rgyud phyi mar/ mu stegs dmod pa spangs pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas btsun mo sbas pa yin/ /ces pas/ rdor dbyings pa rdo rje sogs mtshan ma tsam 'bri la/ sbyong rgyud du ni dngos su yul rnams 'bri bar yang gsungs so/ /nang sgeg bzhi ni/ sems dpa' rnams kyi btsun mo ste/ /rgyud du/ rigs kyi lha mo chen mo zhes pa'i 'grel par rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa de'i lha mo yang yin la chen mo yang yin pas lha mo chen mo ste/ de'i btsun mo zhes pa'i don no zhes so/ /bdug pa ma g.yog mo'i gtso/ me tog ma gsol kha/ mar me ma pho nya ma/ byug pa ma bran mo lta bu'o/ /zhes de nyid snang chen du bshad do/ /yang lcags kyu ni g.yog mo'i gtso bo/ zhags pa ni gsol kha ba/ lcags sgrog pho nya ba/ 'bebs pa bran lta bu'o/ /zhes kyang bshad do/ /de ltar na lha so bdun du grangs nges te/

rtse mor/ mgon po rnam par snang mdzad che/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba chen po bzhi/ /sems dpa' chen po bcu drug dang / /gsang chen lha mo bcu gnyis dang / /sgo bsrung ba ni bzhi dag ste/ /sum cu rtsa bdun las mi nyung / /zhes bshad do/ /gnyis pa byed las ni/ dkyil 'khor du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ rdo rje sems dpa' byang chub kyi sems la rab tu bzhag rgyal po spyan drangs phyi rnam bzhag bzhi phyi'i khro bo rdo rje zhags pa sogs rtsa ba'i lha min nam snyam na nang na yod pas rtsa ba'i lhar mi 'jog gi sngon sprul bshad kyi dus na gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spyan sogs nas 'bebs pa'i bar bskyed nas/ gdan so so ma bkod pa rtsa ba'i lha dang / de dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs rjes la/ skal bzang byang chub sems dpa' nas dus kyi dril bu'i bar byung nas/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma rnams la bzhugs pa rnams mgron thabs yin mkhas pa 'ga' gsungs/ chags pas mnyes/ /legs pas legs so zhes bya bas dges par byas/ rin chen gyis dbang bskur/ gzi brjid kyis 'od kyis snang bar byas/ rgyal mtshan gyis sbyin pa'i phar phyin la sbyar/ bzhad pas 'dzum pa pad+ma 'byung ba la bzhag chos kyis ting nge 'dzin la sbyar/ /rnon pos nyon mongs bcad/ rgyus dkyil 'khor du bcug smra bas spros med kyi chos la nges par sbyar/ las kyis mchod pa ma lus pas mchod/ srung bas bsrungs/ gnod sbyin gyis bskyangs/ khur tshur gyis sku gsung thugs gcig tu sgrub pa'i rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas pa la/ mi bskyod pas rigs thams cad byang chub kyi sems su bsdus pa sems ma rdo rje ma/ rin 'byung gis rigs thams cad sbyin par bsdus pa rdo rje rin chen ma/ 'od dpag med kyis rigs shes rab tu bsdus pa/ rdo rje chos mas las kyi rigs thams cad brtson 'grus su bsdus pa rdo rje las ma rnams kyis rgyas btab/

sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus rnams dag pa nang gi lha mo bzhi dang / shes rab/ bsam bstan/ smon lam/ thabs kyi phar phyin dag pa'i phyi'i lha mo ste brgyad kyis mchod/ lcags kyus thar pa'i grong du bkug zhags pas bcug lcags sgrogs gis bcings/ dbab pas dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sgo nang ma'i sgo ba'i 'di dag pa/ mkhas pa mang bsod dbang / spru lung / bu ston po khro bo sems dpa'i skyil krung byas par bshad la/ ko sa lar/ g.yas brkyang / g.yon brkyang / sa ga zlum po'i stabs su 'dod pa dang / /shākya thub pa'i skabs nas/ dpa' bo lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril snyan rnams bzhag ces dang / 'jigs byed brgyad kyi skabs las kyang / khro bor bshad do/ /bla ma rje btsun ni 'di dag lha mo bzhed pas gzhan dag bzhengs pa khro bo'i cha lugs can zer yang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kun nas ma bshad pas ma yin no/ /zhes dgag pa'ang mdzad do/ /'on kyang 'di dag rgya dper pho rtags kyi sgras gsungs so/ /de nas sgo phyi nang gi bar gyi khyams kyi lha snam rim pa gnyis sam gsum la/ dang po la byang sems bcu drug rtsa rig gam/ rdo rje 'byung ba sogs ltar na/ oṃ sarba saṃ ka ra pa ri shud+dha dharma te mahā na ya pa ri wa ra swāhā/ zhes pa 'di bskyed par bshad la/ 'di dag gi sku mdog phyag mtshan/ ji ltar mngon par dga' ba'i rgyan dang ldan par 'byung bar bshad la/ mgron thabs stong nyid bcu drug rtogs pas ye shes skal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug bden pa bcu drug rtogs pas nyan thos bcu drug rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtogs pas rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i khro bo brgyad yin/ rin shes gsung ngo / /lha 'di dag spyan drangs kyi lha yin pas bskyed mi dgos kyang la la zer ro/ /rgyas na gtsug dgu'i gzhung du byams pa mdog ser 'od bzang la/ g.yas na klu shing me tog bsnams/

/g.yon spyi blug legs par 'dzin/ ces pa nas/ kun tu bzang po zhes bya ste/ sku mdog ser zhing 'od 'bar ba/ /phyag rgya g.yas pa'i phyag na ni/ /rin chen snye ma bsnams pa la/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur kun brtan pa'o/ /zhes bshad do/ /bsdu na/ 'grel chen du/ byams pa la sogs pa yang shar gyi char ni rdo rje sems dpa' 'dra bar rdo rje bsnams pa'o/ /zhes dang / dum bu gnyis pa'i dkyil chog tu'ang / /sems dang po bzhi dang 'dra bar bshad do/ /zang dkar lo tsā ba na re/ byang sems stong gi pha gcig pa'i spun yin/ bcu drug po 'di sems lhan cig tu bskyed pa'i grogs mched yin gsungs te dpyad do/ /de na rigs lnga ni rdo rje skyil krung can te/ de dag kyang go rim bzhin du/ thugs rje chen po sgyu 'phrul dra bar/ g.yas pa'i byin pa dang ni brla dbus su/ /rkang pa g.yon pa mnyam par bzhag par bya/ /de'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag pa ni/ /de ni rdo rje skyil krung yin zhes de nyid 'dus par rdo rje sems dpa' rnams/ rdo rje phyed pa'i gdan la bzhugs zhes te/ thams cad sems dpa'i skyil krung can no/ /bya/ /zhes dang / de nyid du/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i brla'i steng du ni/ /rkang pa g.yas pa cung zad tsam sbyar la/ /g.yon pa bskum 'og tu bzhag pa ni/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung tu rab tu grags/ /zhes so/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror sgrol ma sngo ljang gi bzhugs stabs lta bu la/ sems skyil du bshad pa yod ces bla ma rje btsun gsung ngo / /gzhan rnams ni sla la/ rgyas par bskyed pa la gnyis te/ rgyas par brtsams/ spro bsdu las bskyed pa dang / shin tu rgyas par mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa'i dang po ni/ bla ma rje btsun gyis gsung gis/ spro bsdus bskyed na/ gdan gyi steng du snying po blo gros bskyed/ mtha' skor du rtsa rig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis tshul du byas nas 'od bsdus te/

yi ge la bzhugs pa las/ kun rig la sogs par bskyed de/ 'og ma rnams la yang des shes par bya'o/ /gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mor/ ā li las zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ kā li las zla ba gnyis pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su bskyed sngags so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ de gsum las 'od spro bsdu gcig tu 'dres pa bya grub ye shes/ de yongs su rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi par bskyed pa ste/ yo ga spyi skad la 'di ltar yin no/ /de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ de ltar mdun du dam tshig pa bskyed nas ye shes pa 'gugs pa rgyas pa/ 'bring po ni rdul tshon la spyan 'dren/ shin tu bsdus pa ras ris dang / /lugs ma la spyan 'dren no/ grags 'od mar rnam snang gi thugs kar lha so so'i bskyed sngags dang rtsa rig lha so so bskyed nas thugs ka nas byung / so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod par bshad pa ni ches nor te/ gtso bo'i thugs kha nas 'khor spro ba sngon byung sprul bshad kyi lugs yin gyi/ de rdul tshon la byed pa bzhad gad kyi gnas so zhes rje btsun gsungs te legs so/ /spyan 'dren tshul yang bsdus pa ni/ rin chen 'bar ba nas 'byung ba ltar/ ma lus sems can sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis so/ /'bring ni/ de'i steng du bcom ldan bskal pa sogs sh+lau ka gnyis so/ /rgyas pa byed na/ de'i steng du chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug sogs brjod do/ /de nas de nyid snang bar/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas/ phyi 'brangs kyi bgegs bsal bar bshad pa ltar bya'i/ su bha ni dang rdo dril bzung ste tsham ngam byed pa sogs ye nas ma bshad do/ /de nas mchod pa sogs byas/ sbyong rgyud du/ lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor gyis/ /gsang bas bcing bas bcings nas ni/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/

/zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang / /de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du bya/ /mtheb gnyis nang du bcug nas kyang / /skyod par gyur na dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar gyis dgug gzhug sogs bya/ de nas 'di'i phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs ni cis kyang dgos te/ rnal 'byor rgyud la phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs med na/ dam tshig pa ye shes pa'i rang bzhin du mi 'gyur/ sgrub pa'i yan lag bcu drug mi tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /bcu drug ni phyag rgya bzhi dang dgug sogs bzhi/ byin rlabs dbang bskur ting 'dzin mchod/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig pa'o/ /zhes pa rnams so/ /rgyas 'debs sogs logs su shes par bya'o/ /rje btsun gyis kyang phyag rgya bzhi rgyas pa ni rgyud 'dir mi gsung yang legs par brtags na phyag rgya bzhi mngon par ni kho bos mthong ste/ dam tshig phyag rgya ni dngos su bshad la/ las kyi phyag rgya ni 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i skabs nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rjes la/ de nyid gnyis su byas nas gar byas na las kyi'o zhes dang / chos kyi phyag rgya de nyid las/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi sa bon lta bu bshad la/ phyag rgya chen po ni shugs las grub pa yin no gsungs ba ltar legs so/ /rgyas btab nas rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs shing / rigs lnga'i dbang blang / kha de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la dang byang sems brgyad la rdo rje rin chen gyi dam rgya dang / badz+wa rat+nā a bha ṣiñtsa'i rdo rje rin po che'i cod pan/ yum nas 'bebs pa'i bar la rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan/ phyi'i khro bo dang 'jig rten pa rnams la ti rin ti ri'i sngags rgyas rdo rje phreng ba thams cad la thun mong du tu sh+yas dar dpyang gi dbang bskur ro/ cig bsod dbang / dgug gzhug tshar rjes de ma thag 'di gnyis byed pa'ang yod de/ dam ye ma 'dres par dbang mi bskur ro/ /de nas rtsa rig sogs bzlas pa ci nus bya/

de rjes 'phrin las gzhol te/ dam rgya'i phyag gsang ba'am/ dkon snying ltar na 'chol tshul/ chen gyis so/ de nas mchod bstod bya ba ni/ sbyong rgyud du/ ar+ghaṃ mchog rtags gsang ba la sogs pa'i/ /bstod dbyangs snyan pas bstod dang lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces pa'i don rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kun snying ltar na/ kyi dngos su 'byor ba'i mchod pa dang / gsang ba ste lha mo brgyad dang / sogs pa ste mchod pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lha rdzas ste yid las 'byung ba rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa'o zhes so/ /dngos kyi mchod pa/ rab 'byams sogs te sngar bshad de sla'o/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa ma ni 'khor chen gyi mchod chog las 'byung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi sogs ni rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba las so/ /sbyong rgyud las byung ba'i mchod pa nyer lnga ni/ rin chen mdzes pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgur rgyan sogs pa/ rkang grangs su rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'o/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra hā ham̐ badz+ra la s+ye zhes brjod pas rang gi snying ga nas/ sgeg mo dpag med 'phros/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod 'dod pa dang / dga' bas mchod pa/ slar snying gar bsdus/ de bzhin du/ badz+ra rat+na ma nuta ri badz+ra ma le zhes pas phreng ba ma dpag med 'phros/ phreng ba/ gdub bu/ rnam rgyan/ dbu rgyan sogs kyis mchod/ badz+ra dharma gā yā ni/ badz+ra girti zhes pas glu mas glus mchod/ badz+ra karma ka ro da bhā we badz+ra n+yi rti zhes pas gar mar gar gyis mchod/ tshur 'dus so/ /'di la slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba ni/ la s+ye sogs rang gi snying pos thog drangs nas re re la gru rdzogs par len par bzhed de/ shākya bshes gnyen glu'i tshig re re dang snying po spel bar 'dod/ rje btsun ni de gnyis gang byas kyang chog gsung ngo /

/sngags don ni byang chub kyi sems dang mi bskyod pa'i rigs ni rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa'i stobs kyis bsdus pa ste rtogs pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang / de'i brus rin chen gyi rigs ni rdo rje rin chen te bla na med pa'o/ /sher phyin rang pa'i rigs ni rdo rje chos so/ /glur blangs pa ni chos kun rang bzhin gyis dag go zhes pa'o/ /brtson 'grus dang las kyi rigs ni rdo rje ste de la bod pa'o/ /'gro don byed pa ni las yin pas de rdzogs par byed par 'gyur zhes gsol ba 'debs so/ /rgyud phyi mar/ bdug pa la sogs mchod byas la/ /de nas dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /sgrub na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de nas yid 'byung gi mchod pa ni/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / byang chub gzhung lam du bshad pa'i oṃ sarba bid pu ra pū ra sogs kyi rin chen sna bdun sprul te/ 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul ba sogs ni/ mdo ru 'byung zhing rnam 'joms rdo rje go cha'i dkyil chog na yod de/ de yang dgongs pa rab gsal du/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa ser po/ glang po che mche ba drug ldan dkar po/ rta ljang gu bud med lo bcu drug lon pa sngo sang / nor bu cha brgyad pa ser po/ khyim bdag dmar po/ dmag dpon smug gri phub 'dzin pa'o/ /sgron gsal du/ dmag mi ral gri bshad de/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs ni/ 'jam dpal yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyud dang / rdo rje go cha'i dkyil chog nas 'byung ngo / /de nas bstod pa bya ste/ chos dbyings ye shes sogs sh+lau ka bdun ni/ kun snying la kha 'phang byas pa'i smri ti'i dkyil chog las 'byung ngo / /rdo rje sems dpa' che sogs bcu drug ni/ de nyid 'dus pa'i dum bu dang po na bzhugs so/ /sgeg sogs brgyad dang / bsgo ba rnams smri ti'i dkyil chog las byung ngo / /mgron thams cad kyi lha rnams bstod pa smri ti nas/

rje btsun gyis btus pa yin no/ /'di dag gi 'bru gnon ni/ logs shig tu bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma ni/ sbyong rgyud du/ 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya/ /zhes pa 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya zhes pa 'byung po phyi'i gtor ma gcig de nas phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag ces pas phyogs skyong rnams la re re'am thun mong du gcig gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces pas bgegs gtor te gtor ma cha gsum dang / sems can bkres shing skom la btung ba dang / /zhes pas rigs drug dang yi dwags la gtor ma gcig sbyin par bya'o/ /cho ga ni/ de'i gtor ma ji ltar mthun par bya/ /zhes pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bya zhing / shrā dhas mdzad pa'i cha gsum gyis btang pa la yang 'gal ba med do/ /dpal mchog bstod 'grel du/ a ka ros phyi rol du gtor ma ster ba shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul yang gsungs so/ /'das gtor ni/ ma bshad pas bya mi dgos la/ cis kyang na/ a ka ro'am/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi dbul lo/ /de nas bdag 'jug byed pa ni/ /'og nas 'byung ba ltar de sla'o/ /de nas gson po yin na de'i rjes la 'jug pa yin la/ gshin po la yang / rtsa ba'i rgyud du/ gshin la gson bzhin dbang bskur na/ ngan song gnas su skyes na yang / /de nyid grol bar the tshom med/ /ces pa'i thog mar yang rten bskyed pa yin te/ de yang 'di ltar sgeg pa rdo rje ṇi las bskyed pa bshad cing / kho rang gi ming yig dang po thig las brgyan pa las tha mal pa'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin bskyed nas/ rnam shes 'gugs pa jo bo rin chen bzang po'i man ngag yin la/ man snyer bud med spyan ma dang / skyes pa rnam snang du bskyed nas rang rang gi sa bon las/ ye shes sems dpa' bcug nas de'i sa bon gyi 'od zer dang / rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyis bar do'i srid pa bkug nas bzhugs zhes lha bskyed nas rnam shes 'gugs zer yang snga legs so/

/yo ga stod lugs pa rnams de'i don du dmigs nas cho ga byas pas chog gi rnam shes dgug mi dgos/ bkug kyang mi khugs/ khugs na gson por 'gyur ro zer ro/ /de yang gson por 'gyur bar srid par dus 'khor mchog mi 'gyur gyi skabs kyi shi log gi dper brjod na/ sman bla'i mdo las/ slar ldog cing dran pa rnyed la bshad pas so/ /bu ston gsung ngo / /gal te bla mtshe 'ang / chos mngon par/ sngon gyi pha ma dang grogs shes kun bar dor rmi lam gyi tshod tsam du mthong bar bshad pas bar do nas dar rmi lam du 'jug pa mi 'gal ba dang / des skye ba gzhan blangs par der dngos su 'ong ba'i skabs med pa zhig yin na'ang / 'gugs pa'i cho ga byas nas der bsgom pas phan yon che'i/ de lta min na phan chung ste/ /dper na dgra bo la drag las byed pa dag gis/ ling ga la dgra bo'i rnam shes bkug nas/ drag las byas na dngos su ma khugs kyang rten 'brel gyi dbang gis/ de la gnod pa bzhin/ gal te dngos su ma khugs nas don med na/ lha sgom pa la dngos su lhar mi 'gyur bas don med par 'gyur du 'ong ngo / /des na lus kyi de nyid 'dus pa nas bshad pa'i rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings pa'i mdzub mo gnyis brkyang pa cung zad bskums nas lcags kyu ltar byas pa gsang ba'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya las/ mthe chung gnyis khab ltar brkyangs pa ro'i mgo bor bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dza dza zhes ngag tu brjod/ bden pa brdar/ sems kyi snying ka'i rdo rje las dza las skyes pa'i rdo rje lcags kyu spros nas tshe las 'das pa'i rnam shes kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba a thung gzugs bsam/ mar me lta bu bkug nas khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag rgya'i/ /srid pa'i phung po dkug par bya/ /zhes so/ /spyi gtsug nas zhugs te snying gar thim par bsam la/ lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dza dza la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bcing mnyes par bya'o/

/de yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i dus mtha'i cho gar/ snying kha'i sa bon las ni grub pa bzang / /'khor los mtshan pa'i lcags kyu spro bar bya/ /de yis gshin po 'jig rten pha rol song / /sems ni mdog dmar gsal ba dgugs bya ste/ /chos kyi sgo mo'i gzugs bsam yang na ni/ /rlung me mar me mi g.yo lta bu'o/ /'ong nas de'i shes pa snying gar ni/ /ro'i spyi bo nas ni gzhug par bya/ /de ni shes pa dang ni yang dag ldan/ /de rjes langs nas 'dug pa blta bar bya/ /de snying mo ha ra ti bkod nas ni/ /de yi 'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba yis/ /de yi lus ni stong par byas/ /lhag ma rig byed tsam nyid ni/ /de yi rjes la mo ha ra ti zhes/ /brjod pas spyan gyi gzugs su bsgom nas ni/ /de yi mig dang sku la sogs pa dag /thams cad du ni byin gyis brlab par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bgegs sbyangs pa'i don/ 'chi 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba lung bstan pa'i mdo las dper na rlung chen pos/ thang dang rlung yang pa dag dus gcig rlung ldang ba bzhin du/ 'chi 'pho ba thams cad kyi sems la khyab par byed pa'i rigs/ dri za pi tsa na zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin smra 'dod kyi rigs dang / 'byung po wa ra ha ta kun tu rtogs 'dod ces bya ba dag gis sgrub nas/ ma ma yin pa de dag gis shi ba des sngon ji ltar gtam byas pa dang / cha lugs kyi ngan rtags dag 'jig rten bslu ba'i phyir/ ston cing smra ba dag yin no/ /zhes tshe 'das pa'i cha byad bzung nas nye 'brel sogs la gnod par gsungs pa dang / tshe 'das skye ba blangs pa'i gnas su dge ba dang / bde ba la bar du gcod pa dag tshar bcad pa'i ched du drag po'i sbyin bsreg bya bar gsungs la/ de tsam ma grub na/ legs grub tu/ dang por 'jam de nyid kyis bya/ /lan gnyisalan tshe na dbye bar brtson/ /ces dang / gtsug dgur/ yi ge hūm̐ gi sgra sgrogs par/ /cung zad gar byed goms stobs kyis/

sogs bshad pas gtor ma rten la skor ba/ zhi ba/ ting lo chang bu sbags pa skor ba phyed ma/ khro bo spyan drangs te sngags zlos pa drag por bshad par bya ste bgegs sbyang ba'i/ bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud du/ sgrub bya'i rkang pa dag la ni/ /gzhu yi rnam pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ /lte bar ye shes yang dag 'bar/ /de yi snying khar 'bar ba yis/ /'od zer 'bar ba kun tu 'khrigs/ /paṃ gyur sdig pa mi zad pa/ /sna'i sgo nas phyung nas ni/ /de nas khro bo'i gzugs bsgoms te/ /kun tu zos par bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ tshe 'das kyi rkang gnyis su rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ snying khar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag sogs la sgo gsum gyi sdig pa kun 'dus par bsam la/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od kyis snying kha'i paṃ dod nas sna sgo nas 'thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas til gyi phung po la thim par bsam la/ ye bsang ste/ khro bo bskyed nas/ oṃ badz+ra ḍa sogs brjod do/ /de nas phyir zlog gi sdig pa sbyangs ba ni/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung du/ de nas phyir zlog bya ba ni/ /yungs kar gyis ni bya ba yin/ /yungs kar me tog dang ldan pa/ /sngags rnams bzlos shing brdeg par bya/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ shi ba'i rus bu'am/ re sogs la brdeg par gsung pa'i sngags/ durga ti dang / las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod kyi gzungs bzlas pa'am/ til lam yungs kar ram/ chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod byas te/ rus pa'am/ shi ba'i ro la gtor ram/ khrus byas nas ngan song las thar bar gsungs so/ /kaṃ ka ni dang / rnam rgyal gyi rtog par/ sdig pa byed pa gang dag shi ba'i dus byas pa de dag gi don du gzungs 'di yungs kar dag la lan gcig yongs su brjod de/ de dag gis rus gong rnams kyi steng du gtor na de dag sems can dmyal ba'am/

dud 'gro'i skye gnas sam/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten/ yi dwags sam/ de las gzhan ngan 'gro rnams su skyes par gyur kyang rung ste/ de dag gzungs 'di'i mthus ngan 'gro de las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag las thar nas kyang lhar skye bar 'gyur ro zhes rnam rgyal dang / de dang phan yon 'dra ba dri med dang / /cho ga zhib mo las/ oṃ pad+mo uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi ma le hūm̐ phaṭ/ sems can gang la la dmyal bar gzhol ba shi ba dang / dge slong la la bslab pa'i sdom pa dang / tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ral ba dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon la gus par ma byas par shi ba de'i don du bye ma gtsang ma blangs la sngags lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas dur khrod dam/ ro bsreg pa'am/ mchod pa der bye ma gtor bas/ gang dang gang na sems can gang gi rus pa yod pa der bye ma gtor ma thag tu/ de dang der bye ma babs pa'i sems can dmyal ba'am/ yi dwags sam/ sha zar skyes sam/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'i skye gnas su skyes na de de'i mod la tshe brjes nas thams cad mtho ris su gzhol bar 'gyur zhing / nam yang sems can dmyal bar gzhol bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas dngos su ro yod na brdeg med na ming byang la brab/ gzhan yang kun rig dang / gtsug dgu nas bshad pa'i brab sngags rnams kyis kyang brab bo/ bkrus te sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ /gtsug dgur/ rus pa'am gos sam ming la ni/ /de rjes chu yis bkru bar bya/ /sdig pa bkru ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /srid gsum dri ma bkru bar bya/ /zhes pas rten rab gnas can la khrus gsol nas byed pa la lag len jo bo'i mi 'khrugs pa'i gzhung las/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /sogs dang / durga ti spel te bkru/ kun snying gis bkru sngags durga ti la ma bshad do/ /gtsug dgu'i rgyud brtag pa phyogs gcig par ni/ rigs lnga'i sngags gsungs te/ de ltar na/ bum pa lngar rigs lnga bskyed de/

sngags 'di dag bzlas te zhu ba las byung ba'i chur byas la bkru ste/ mi 'khrugs rgyal po gti mug rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang / /dge ba mnyam med rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis des kyang deng sdig sgrib sbyongs/ bar do'i 'jigs skrag dang yang bral nas bde ba can du pad+mo las brdzus te skyes nas dge bar gyur cig ces kyang brjod do/ /'dir zhi byed legs gyur cig oṃ kaṃ ka ni bzlas te/ khyad par nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi dri ma dag nas/ me long lta bu'i ye shes su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces dang / sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan gyis brgyan mdzad cing / /yang dag sbyin mdzad 'gro ba'i don la mi bslu ba'i/ /rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya'i bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis des kyang sogs 'dra'o/ /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne mahā rat+ne rat+na sam+bha we rat+na ma la bi shud+dhe shwa dhā ya sarba pa paṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma dag nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan gyi skur sogs 'dre'o/ /sems can don du thugs ni rab tu dgongs mdzad ste/ 'gro ba mtha' dag 'ching ba'i bcings las grol mdzad pa/ /thub mchog don yod grub pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des kyangྎ oṃ a mo gha a pra tī ha ta/ sarba a wa ra ṇa ṇi bi shā ni ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa phrag dog gi dri ma dag nas bya grub ye shes su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa'i skur sogs so/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin dam pa pha rol phyin pa'i gnas/ /ye shes pad+ma'i steng bzhugs dpag med tshe ldan pa/ /tshe grangs med par byin gyi rlobs pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des kyangྎ oṃ a mi te/ a mi te/

a mi tod bha we/ a mi ta sam+bha we/ a mi tā bikrān+te/ a mi ta gā mi ne/ sarba karmā kā la sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka rī swāhā/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag nas so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi sku sogs so/ /rnam par snang mdzad ye shes dam pa mtsho chen ldan/ /zla ba nya 'dra'i sku mnga' srid pa mthar phyin pa/ /dgongs pa mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkri shes des kyangྎ oṃ puṇ+ya puṇ+ya mahā puṇ+ya a pa ri mi ta a yu puṇ+ye saṃ bha ra u pa dza ya ka ri ṇi swāhā/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa gti mug gi dri dag nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig ces brjod do/ /de nas dug dbyung ba'i phyir bden stobs brjod par bya'o/ /gtsug dgu'i gzhung du/ slar yang bkra shis tshigs bcad kyis/ /dus gsum du ni khrus bya'o/ /zhes pas/ gang la ser sna rnam chags sogs brjod cing khrus bya 'o/ /de nas skyabs 'gro ni/ bsdu na de nyid 'dus par/ tshe 'das dang / ngan song gsum po thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das bdag sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di la skyabs tu gsol/ bdag rnams sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / khyod la yang skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa tsam gyis chog go /rgyas pa la spro na/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ces sogs brjod la/ de las kyang rgyas pa la spro na/ zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i smre sngags kyi bstod pa bya'o/ /zhes bu ston gsung ngo / /kun snying gi brab pa dang bkru pa tsam la phyir zlog tu gsungs mod kyi/ bla ma rnams skyabs 'gro dang bcas pa phyir bzlog tu bzhed do/ /de nas dngos gzhi la dbang bskur ba ni/ dkyil chog las 'byung ba ltar bskur te/

sngar dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob na rdzogs par bskur/ ma thob na dbang bskur lan gsum bzhi song nas rdzogs par bskur ro zhes gsung ngo / /mjug tu mchod bstod byas la lam ston par bya ste/ gtsug dgur dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du/ /nas/ 'phags pa'i lam de bgrod par shog /oṃ rat+ne sogs brjod pas lam bstan nas/ lam sbyang ba ni/ pad+ma 'dam gyi ma gos ltar nas/ bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me sogs brjod cing / me tog dor te/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes dang / ye shes pa'i lha dbyer med du 'dres nas/ spyi gtsug nas 'thon te/ bde ba can du pad+ma la rdzus te skyes pa la/ de'i gzhir gnas kyi byang sems rnams kyis mchod/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong / gdams pa thob pa cho ga rnam dag gi mthur shes te/ lha de dag gis bdag la mchod cing / sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i dge ba med/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i snod med ste/ /sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /ces ched du brjod par bsam/ de dag kyang skye ba'i rgyu brtags pas cho ga'i mthur shes nas skad cig la 'dir 'ongs te/ ai ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /sogs kyi ched du brjod de/ mchod pa nyer lnga sogs mchod pa'i khyad par du mas mchod/ bstod nas/ slar bde ba can du song bar bsam zhing / bdag gis kyang mchod la/ oṃ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra gats+tsha na tu swāhā/ go rim 'di bla ma rje btsun dang / gtsug dgur bshad la/ nag po pa dang / stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes/ sngon la lam sbyangs te/ de nas lam ston par mdzad do/ /nag po pas tshe 'das kyi rnam shes a thung gi rnam pa yaṃ las rlung bteg nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar thim pa'ang gsungs so/ /de nas lha dang rnam shes gshegs pa'i ro lta bu byang bu de bsreg par bya'o/ /ma bsregs kyang skyon cung zad med do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor kyi lha la mchod bstod byas nas/

lha rang rang gi dam rgya bcas te/ rang rang gi snying po gsum gsum gyi mthar badz+ra muḥzhes brjod cing se gol byas te bkrol la/ rdo rje rin chen dam rgya dang / badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsas dbang bskur/ gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog tu phyag rgya gnyis gcig tu byas te mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi go bkon snyam pas mnyes par bya/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyangs pa'o/ /ro bsreg pa'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyang ba la/ nag po pa/ thabs kyi khyad par ro bsreg pa/ gnyis su gson cig dgongs shig shes bya ste/ sgrub thabs la bsreg par bya ba dang / dur khrod bsreg par bya'o zhes gsungs pa ltar lugs gnyis yod pa'i/ sgrub thabs te bsreg par bya ba/ nang gi sbyin bsreg byas te/ ro la dngos su rol shing bza' bar bshad la/ dur khrod bsreg pa ni/ ro la dbang bskur ba khrus bya ba la sogs pa tshar nas/ thab khung du/ kun snying gis bshad pa ltar/ ras sam shog bu khru gang pa la/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar/ pad+ma 'am 'khor los mtshan pa la/ zhun mar gyi snos pas/ ro'i gdan du bting / rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ slob dpon gyi gdan gyi phyogs su kha bstan la bzhag steng nas ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags kyis btab pa'i dar ram ras kyi g.yogs te/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ji lta ba bzhin bya'o/ /khyad par bla ma rje btsun pa/ la sogs pa gang zag mchog gi pur la skal bzang dga' ba/ dbang bskur ba dang / gdung bzhu ba dang / rten bzhengs pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni khrus byas/ yi ge gdags/ chas gos dang rgyan drug bkon khri la bzhag pur stong pa'i ngang las sngar gyi bla mar bskyed sngar gyi rnam shes 'gugs pa'i sngags rgyas/ sangs rgyas kyang 'gugs pas de dang / ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa'i tshigs bcad dang / sngags kyi spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug sogs bya/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs sbyangs/ de nas dkyil 'khor gtso bskyed/

ye shes pa dgug rgyas btab/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ dbang bskur/ brab pa dang / brab dang dug bsal ba bzhag nas/ rab gnas kyi skabs ltar phyin drug dang / bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod la/ khrus gsol/ mchod pa rgyas par dbul/ bla ma'i bstod pa mang po bya/ bdun rnam dag sogs bya/ dbang bskur pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i bya ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos mdzad/ slob ma'i bya ba bla ma de nyid kyis mdzad/ bdag de'i mchod g.yog pa'i tshul gyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo gsung ba ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsrung pas mdzad pa'i gdung chog las kyang 'byung ngo / /bla ma dngos min yang gang zag dam pa kun la 'di bya'o zhes mkhas mchog bu ston gsung / rjes lam sbyang bstan mi dgos/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dbang bskur ba'o/ /pur sbyang ba ni/ pur chas su bzhug lhar bskyed/ de'i thugs kar lha dpa' bo gcig pa'am/ yongs su rdzogs pa bskyed nas/ de dang pur gyis ye shes pa gcig tu bsres pa la mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ chos 'brel med pa'i mi'i me sbor zhes bla ma 'phags 'od gsung ngo / /'ga' zhig tu slob mas bla ma bsregs na nye ba'i mtshams med du 'gro zer te/ gur gyi 'grel par yang / de'i snying kar rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa bskyed la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang gcig tu bsres la mnyam pa nyid du gshegs su gsol bar dmigs te zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi gnas su bsreg cing sbyangs pa'o/ /gal te de ltar ma byas na mchod rten bshig pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni bla ma ma yin yang / /sngon nas lha sgom pa kun la bya'o zhes bu ston gsung / de nas ro mchod yul du bsreg pa'i tshul ltar bya zhing / dpal ldan bla ma zhing khams gang na bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi bar chad thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru zhes pa'i spel tshig bya'o/

/pur sbyang ba'o/ /rten bzheng pa ni de nas nyi ma gsum pa la/ rus pa'i phreng ba bsdu bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ me ma shi na 'o mas bzhil te/ snod gtsang mar gdung thal rnams bsdus te/ rten gsum ji ltar rigs pa bzhengs pa'o/ /de dag gis ni sngon gyi mkhas pa lo tsā ba ngag dbang grags pa'i gsung las byung ba ltar bshad zin nas// ༈ //gnyis pa sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin mtshungs med dpal ldan ngor pa'i rjes 'brang gi lugs ltar bshad pa ni rgyal bas lung bstan brnyes pa kun dga' bzang po dang / de'i thugs sras rgyal tshab dam pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i srol 'dzin mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇa chen nyi zla seṅges mdzad pa'i gzhan phan rtsod 'jom rtsa 'grel ltar bshad pa la/ thog mar rtsa ba gzhung tshigs su bcad pa la 'di ltar 'byung ste/ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma rnam snang ston pa dang / /bsdud byed bsgyur gsal mdzad rnams rgyal/ /mtha' yas rtsod 'phrul rags spong tshul/ /shes len de 'bras thob phyir bris/ /sbyor dngos rjes skabs rtsod 'khrul rnams/ /'khrul gnod 'gal med kyis sun dbyung / /ma tshang steng 'og a mtshon sogs/ /rtsig ngos bris bkram phyogs log rnams/ /ma gsungs 'gal gnod phyir 'khrul spangs/ /'byung gtor sngon 'gro sa chog zer/ /lung med thug med der dgag bya/ /srung 'khor lhag chad nor ldan gyi/ /'dir rtsod de yang des sun byung / /bdag bskyed go rim gleng gzhi dang / /lha sngags bstod pa ye shes gshegs/ /drug pa 'khrul nas 'dir rtsod byed/ /de yang lam rim sgrib bral dang / /rnam snang dbye ba rtsa rig nang / /mtshan grangs ye shes dbye bas ldog /bum grangs lha'i bskyed chog dang / /bum pa'i bzlas sngags lha zhu'i tshul/ /gzhi la 'khrul rtsod de dag ni/ /lung rig man ngag gsum gyis dag /rten dang brten pa'i bskyed tshul dang /
