gzhan yang / mkha' la dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de ltar byas 'og phyag lnga yang / /zhes sogs tshogs shing mchod par bshad pa sogs lag len spros pa'i tshogs mang du 'byung ba dang / bu ston rin po che sogs kyang / bum pa sta gon gyi skabs su/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs mdzad pa gda' na'ang / sbyong rgyud kyi lugs ma yin pas/ ma byas kyang chog chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur ba 'dug lags/ dri ba bcu drug pa/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo rnam snang de/ zhal bzhi kho nar nges lags sam/ des na lo tsā rin chen mchog /'jam dbyangs ral gri la sogs pa'i/ /zhal bzhi pa ru bsgyur ba ci/ /ma nges yid ches lung zin nam/ /dngos stobs rigs pa ji ltar yod/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ gtso bo rnam snang zhal bzhi pa kho nar ma nges mod/ rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa dpang por bya na/ zhal bzhi pa'i phyogs 'di nyid yin par gsal te/ de nyid 'dus par/ rnam par snang mdzad zhal bzhir bri'o zhes dang / de nyid snang chen du yang / gtso bo'i zhal bzhi ni/ byang chub kyi sems dang / sbyin pa dang / shes rab dang / brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'o zhes gsungs pa dang / sbyong rgyud lo tsā ba ban+de dza ya rak+ṣi ta dang / rin chen mchog gis bsgyur ba las/ dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun+da zla 'dra la/ /zhal bzhi pa la rdo rje yi/ /seṅge'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgyar ldan pa dang / /zhes 'byung ba dang / 'bru 'grel las kyang / zhal bzhi pa la rdo rje ni/ /zhes pa ni/ phyogs dang rigs med pa dang / bdag med pas thams cad mnyam pa'i rang bzhin yin pas na zhal bzhi smos te/ ci'i phyir na/ de ni ye shes bzhi rtogs pa'i rang bzhin yin pas smos so/ zhes bshad pa dang / gzhan phan 'od zer sogs las kyang / rnam snang zhal bzhir gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lo tsā ba rin chen mchog gis bsgyur ba'i dpe du ma mthong ba na/

zhal bzhi par bsgyur ba las/ zhal gcig pa ru bsgyur ba ye ma mthong / rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig zhal mtha' yas pa yod pa'ang snang / yang 'jam dbyangs ral gris bsgyur ba'i sbyong rgyud du/ dbus su mgon po kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun+da zla 'dra ba/ /zhal gcig pa ste seṅge yi/ /khri la rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ /zhes 'byung ba 'di tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan zhal gcig tu bshad pa'i gzhung mi snang zhing / 'jam dbyangs ral gri nyid kyis sbyar ba'i kun rig gi rnam bshad du yang / zhal bzhi pa yin pa dag pa dang bcas pa bshad pas/ zhal bzhir 'jam ral rang yang 'dod/ des na zhal bzhi pa dang / zhal gcig pa bzhed pa'i phyogs gnyis las/ snga ma legs par mngon/ rgyu mtshan mang de ma spros lags/ /dri ba bcu bdun pa/ rnam snang la sogs rigs lnga la/ /bsnyen sngags bskyed sngags bum sngags gsum/ /so sor dbye ba bzhed lags sam/ /bzhed na skabs 'dir bum pa la/ /bskyed sngags bzlas pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ /mi bzhed ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar 'grel/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'di la rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi dgongs pa/ rigs lnga la bsnyen sngags sogs gsum du bzhed de/ de yang sbyong rgyud du bshad pa'i/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sogs sngags tshan dang po lnga'i/ oṃ hūm̐ zhes pa'i rje btsun gyi mchan las/ lnga po 'di bsnyen dus su bzlos pa'i sngags so zhes pas bsnyen sngags dang / oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa ra na zhes sogs sngags tshan bar pa lnga'i mchan/ oṃ sarba pa paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shudhe bi shu dhe/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha kun rig ni swāhā/ oṃ shwa dha ni shwa dha ni/ sarba a pa ya/ sarba satwa bh+ya hūm̐/ me tog cher rgyas/ oṃ sarba a bha ya bi shodha ni/ shākya thub hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ṭa ṭha/ rgyal mchog oṃ hūm̐/ sbyongs rgyal/

lnga po 'di bsnyen sngags/ las/ lha bskyed pa dang / dkyil 'khor la 'god pa'i sngags so/ /zhes dang / 'od zer las/ kun rig gi bskyed sngags/ oṃ sarba bid sarba a wa rat+na bi sho dha ya ha/ na hūm̐ phaṭ/ kun rig oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ sbyongs rgyal/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭ/ rin chen/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ shāka thub/ oṃ sarba bid tra thā/ cher rgyas/ lnga po 'di bskyed sngags so/ zhes sogs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor 'byin pa dang / rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor la 'god pa dang gnyis ka'i sngags la nang gi lha ni kun rig las 'byung ba ni/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐ zhes sogs kyis bskyed sngags sam/ 'byin sngags sam/ 'god sngags rnam grangs su bshad/ yang 'od zer las dbang bum lnga la rigs lnga'i sngags bzlas par bshad pa dang / oṃ sarba bid oṃ kun rig sogs sngags tshan phyi ma lnga'i mchan las/ bum pa bzlos pa'i sngags so/ zhes gsungs pas bum sngags/ oṃ sarba bid swa/ sbyongs rgyal/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ rin chen/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ shāka thub/ oṃ sarba bid tra tha/ cher rgyas/ lnga po 'di bum sngags so/ rigs lnga ma gtogs rtsa lha gzhan rnams la sngags gsum dbye ba med/ 'on kyang sems dpa' bcu drug la sbyong rgyud las gsungs pa'i sngags bzhin byas na legs snyam mo/ /ding sang snyigs dus 'dir/ skyo ma snga btsan rna bar bcug nas legs bshad kyi sgron me bstan kyang / gsung rab kyi don la mig mdongs nas/ nges don gyi snying po mi mthong ba rang mang bar gda' ste/ dus kyis bslad pas lan snyam mo/ kye hud/ rnams gsal bar bshad/ 'di bzhin 'jam ṭika na yang bshad/ /de nas rigs lnga la bsnyen bsngags/ bskyed sngags/ bum sngags rnams so sor gsungs pa'i phyir/ bum bzlas la bum sngags bzlos dgos pa rje btsun chen po'i dgongs par gda'/ yang bla ma kha cig gsung las/

yang bum lnga la rigs lnga'i bum sngags dang / rnam rgyal la rigs lnga'i bskyed sngags bzlas dgos pa las/ ding sang bskyed sngags bzlas pa/ dbang bum lnga ma bsham par/ rnam rgyal bum pa kho na'i dbang du byas te/ 'od zer las/ lha thams cad kyi sngags bzlas so zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin gsungs/ yang bum bsnyen bskyed sngags gsum so sor ma bzhed pa'i lugs kyis/ sbyong rgyud las gsungs pa'i/ oṃ sho dha ni sogs sngags tshan bco brgyad po de/ dpral bar mdzod spu rnam pa gnyis/ /zhes pa nas/ mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba yi/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi gnas bco brgyad po byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags su 'dod par 'da' zhing / rje btsun chen pos kyang / mchan dang 'od zer du'ang gsal bar bshad gda' lags/ dri ba bco brgyad pa/ rdor sems la sogs bskyed pa'i sngags/ /satwa hūm̐ dza la sogs pa/ sbyong rgyud gsung las mi bskyed pa/ /hūm̐ dza sogs las bskyed pa ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir sbyong rgyud rnam gnyis dang / gzhan phan 'od zer gyi dgongs pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' sogs la bskyed chog gi rnam grangs/ 'od zer spro bsdu las bskyed pa/ snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa/ rdo rje cho ga las bskyed pa dang / sa bon las bskyed pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ des ni snying gar nyi ma sgom/ /rang gi chos kyi yi ge las/ /'phros nas yang dang yang spro zhing / /de gnyis gcig tu bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang snang bar byas te/ zhes sogs dang / ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba ni rang nyid kyi thugs ka nas mngon par phyung ngo zhes dang / sbyong rgyud gtsug dgu las/ seṅge'i khri'i steng gi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhes sogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rdzogs par gyur te/ zhes pa'i bar dang / sngags rnams kha nas byung nas ni/ /kun nas 'od zer lnga par 'thon/

/kun nas phyogs bcur snang byas nas/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal rnams nas thar mdzad de/ /'od zer rnams ni slar bzlog nas/ /thugs kar zhugs te de rjes la/ /sngags dang 'od zer gnyis 'dres pa/ /las byung sku ni yongs rdzogs pa/ /rdo rje gtsug tor de bzhin gshegs/ /thugs ka las byung 'khor lo yi/ /shar phyogs rtsibs kyi pad zlar bzhugs/ /zhes dang / gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog las/ de nas thugs kar zla ba la/ /bkod pa'i sngags rnams brjod nas ni/ /rdo rje gtsug tor nas brtsams te/ /rdo rje dril bu'i bar du bskyed/ /zhes dang / 'od zer las/ spro bsdu las bskyed pa gang rung bya'o/ /zhes dang / spro bsdu las bskyed na/ gdan gyi steng du snying po la sogs bskyed sngags kyi mtha' skor du rtsa rig bsam pas/ de la 'od 'phros nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa gang rung gi tshul du byas nas/ 'od bsdus te yi ge la zhugs pa las kun rig tu bskyed de/ 'og ma rnams la yang cho ga de nyid kyi rigs 'gre la shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phyogs 'di la mkhas pa phal cher zhal mthun no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'od zer las/ de nas snying po tshig tsam gyi lha rnams bskyed pa'am/ zhes gsungs la/ de la sems dpa' bcu drug snying po la/ rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa las 'byung ba bzhin mdzad pa dang / sbyong rgyud 'di nyid las 'byung ba bzhin mdzad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ go rim bzhin du bri bar bya/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ rje btsun chen po'i mchan las/ sems dpa' bcu drug phyi nang gi lha mo brgyad/ sgo ba bzhi de nyid 'dus pa bzhin du 'god par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don yin la/ sngags ni rdo rje 'byung bar/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ra dzā dza/ oṃ badz+ra rā ga ho sogs so/ /phyogs 'di nyid gzhan phan snying po/ snye ma/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer gyi nyi ma'i 'od zer sogs su gsal bar bkod do/

/gnyis pa rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' mchog ces gsungs pa'i skabs su/ rje btsun chen po'i mchan las/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'og nas bsten/ /zhes gsungs shing / sngags ni 'og 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i skabs su/ sa bcu drug twa bcu drug ba bcu drug dza bcu drug hūm̐ dza ho dhu sogs bcu drug bshad pa'i skabs su/ rje btsun chen po'i mchan las/ drug sgrel du go bar bya/ phrin las mi byed na lngas chog phrin las mi byed na sems dpa' bcu drug po'i sngags kyi mtha' rten du brtags la/ zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin/ skabs 'di'i bla ma'i man ngag gis lnga bsgrel nyid skabs su babs pas/ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ badz+ra satwa dza/ badz+ra satwa ho/ badz+ra satwa dhu zhes sogs las bskyed pa ste/ phyogs 'di nyid bsru lung pa kun smon/ phug ston bsod dbang / bu ston rin po che rjes 'brang sogs mkhas pa du ma'i bzhed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsam nas dam tshig phyag rgya dang / /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du/ /bsgyur zhing sgrub pa po yis ni/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di/ bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka la sbyor bar mdzad de/ rdo rje cho ga las bskyed pa bstan phyogs 'di nyid paṇa chen 'jigs med grags pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'ang bzhed/ bzhi pa ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ hūm̐ dza ho dhu/ traṃ r+ya bh+ri hā/ hri dhi kruṃ bha/ kaṃ raṃ k+ṣaṃ saṃ zhes gsungs te/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi sa bon dngos su bshad pa dang / 'od zer las/ chos kyi phyag rgya'ang de nyid las/ /sems dpa' bcu drug gi sa bon lta ba bshad la zhes dang / hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhes sogs gsungs pas/ 'di'i mtshon nas/ rigs lnga yab yum bzhi yang sa bon las bskyed pa ste/ phyogs 'di nyid/

ldong ston shes rab dpal sogs mkhas pa du ma'i bzhed rgyu don gsal ba yang bzhed/ pa'o/ /de nas hūm̐ dza sogs sa bon las bskyed pa 'di yang sbyong rgyud kyi dgongs pa phyogs gcig yin pa'i phyir/ snying po tshig tsam las nges par bskyed dgos pa ma yin no/ /'on kyang 'od zer las/ rigs lnga yum bzhi snying po tshig tsam las bskyed/ rtsa lha gzhan rnams sa bon las bskyed par gsungs pa ni/ lag len phyogs su lhung pa dgag pa'i phyir/ /de ltar gsungs pa yin gyi/ lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ni/ gong du bshad pa bzhin bskyed chog gang rung ba cig gis lha rnams bskyed dgos pa yin pa gda' lags/ gang dag 'od zer gyi tshig zin bzhin mdzad pa 'di dag la/ cung zad dpyad rgyu gda' na'ang / 'phog thug dum tsam yong pa gda' bas gsal bar ma brjod/ phyogs gang legs khyed rang gi dpyod pa zhu/ dri ba bcu dgu pa sgo ba bzhi pa sbyong rgyud dang / 'od zer mi mthun rgyu mtshan gang / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'di la mkhas pa mang po zhal mthun par/ /sgo ba bzhi po 'di khro bo kho na yin gyis/ khro ma ma yin te/ sbyong rgyud las/ dpa' bo lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu snyan rnams bzhag /zhes dang / sgo bzhir de bzhin sgo ba rnams/ /khros pa'i yid du bri bar bya/ /zhes dang / sgo ba dag kyang khros pa la/ /khro bo'i dbang du gyur pa bri/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de nyid 'dus par yang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje lcags kyu dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje zhags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'bebs pa dang zhes gsungs pa dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs ni/ /khro bo'i cha lugs kho nar nges/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bzhed la/ yang mkhas pa du ma ni/ 'di dag yul skad kyi dbang gis/ pho la mor btags pa dang /

mo la phor btags pa mang po mthong mod/ 'on kyang 'di dag rgya dper/ pho rtags kyi sgras gsungs la/ de dang mthun pa rgyud rnams su yang / pho'i ming gi smos pa yin gyis/ don la khro mo nyid yin par 'thad de/ 'od zer las/ lcags kyu ma dkar mo zhes sogs gsungs pa yin no gsungs par gda'/ phyogs 'di gnyis las/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo dpang por byas na/ sgo ba bzhi khro bo yin par gsal te/ de nyid las/ mgon po rnam par snang mdzad che/ /'khor lo bsgyur ba chen po bzhi/ /sems dpa' chen po bcu drug dang / /gsang chen lha mo bcu gnyis dang / /sgo srung ba ni bzhi dag ste/ /sum cu rtsa bdun las mi nyung / /zhes rtsa lha so bdun du bshad pa'i skabs su/ yum bzhi dang / phyi nang gi sgeg sogs brgyad la/ gsang chen lha mo bcu gnyis zhes gsungs la/ sgo ba bzhi khro mo yin na/ gsang chen lha mo bcu drug tu 'gyur dgos pa las/ de ltar ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro snyam lags/ dri ba nyi shu pa/ phrin las rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dang / shin tu bsdus pa rnam bzhi ru/ /dbye ba skabs 'dir bzhed lags sam/ /bzhed na rje btsun gsung zin gang / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rje btsun chen po'i dgongs pa ni/ /phrin las rgyas 'bring bsdus bzhir mdzad pa gsal te/ de la rgyas pa ni/ 'od zer las/ de nas rang rang gi phyag rgya bstan te/ rtsa rig dang rang rang gi sngags brjod ces gsungs pas/ lha re re la rtsa rig re dang rang rang gi sngags brjod cing dam rgya bstan nas phrin las 'chol ba yin la/ 'bring po ni/ 'od zer las/ rtsa rig thams cad la ma brjod kyang rung ste/ rang rang gi phyag rgya bcings sngags brjod la zhes gsungs pas/ rtsa rig lha thams cad la ma brjod kyang rung bas/ thog mtha' bar gsum ste/ rtsa lha rnams la gcig mgron thab la gcig 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug la gcig dang / rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya bstan nas las 'chol lo/

/bsdus pa ni/ 'od zer las/ rang rang gi sngags sam/ rtsa rig brjod pa'i rjes phrin las gzhol bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ rtsa rig gam rang rang gi sngags brjod phyag rgya bstan nas las 'chol lo/ /'di la rang rang gi sngags brjod pa nyid gtso bor mdzad/ shin tu bsdus pa ni/ 'od zer las/ shin tu bsdus pa la dga' ba la ni phyag rgya bstan mi dgos zhes gsungs pas/ phyag rgya mi ston par rang rang gi sngags sam rtsa rig gang rung brjod pa'i sgo nas 'phrin las 'chol bas/ rje btsun chen po'i dgongs pa la/ phrin las rgyas 'bring bsdus bzhir dbye ba shin tu yang bzhed par gda' lags/ dri ba nyer gcig pa/ kun snying dpal mchog stod 'grel du/ /sgrub pa'i yan lag bcu drug gsungs/ /skabs 'dir sbyor ba ji ltar mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa la/ 'di la bla ma gong ma'i bzhed pa lugs gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ rje btsun chen po'i gzhan phan skor gsum rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i dgongs pa ni/ slob dpon kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i/ de nyid 'dus pa'i 'grel pa de nyid snang chen dang / dpal mchog gi stod 'grel dang gnyis la/ de la sgrub pa'i yan lag bcu drug tu bstan pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po dang / dam tshig dang / chos dang / las kyi phyag rgya dang / dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / bcings ba dang / dbang du bya ba dang / byin gyis brlabs pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags dang / rig pa'o zhes gsungs pa'i/ sgrub pa'i yan lag bcu drug po 'di dag de nyid 'dus pa dang / dpal mchog la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rgyas pa rnams kyi lugs yin la/ sbyong rgyud kyi lugs ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bsdus pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pas/ yan lag bcu drug po nges par sbyor mi dgos la/ dgos na/ de nyid 'dus pa'i snying kha'i bdag 'jug len pa sogs cho ga rgyas pa gzhan rnams kyang 'dir sbyor dgos par 'gyur gsungs par gda'/

gzhan phan 'od zer gyi dngos bstan ltar byas na yang / phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs rgyas pa mi mdzad pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / phyag rgya rnams dngos su mi gsal la/ gzhan rnams 'dod mtshungs tsam las med de/ 'od zer las ye shes pa dgug pa dang gzhug pa dang / bcings ba dang / dbang du byas la/ zhes gsungs pas/ dgug sogs bzhi dang / phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs pa yang / bsdus pa ni/ 'phrin las 'chol ba'i skabs su tshang ste/ rtsa rig brjod dus pad skor byas te de nyid gnyis su byas nas gar bya ba las rgyas dang / rang rang gi sngags brjod pa chos rgya dang / rang rang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan pa dam rgya dang / de'i tshe rang rang gi sku de la yid kyi rtog pa phyag chen ste/ 'od zer las/ de nas rang rang gi phyag rgya bstan te/ rtsa rig rang rang gi sngags brjod ces sogs kyi gsal bar bstan/ ting nge 'dzin yang / mdun bskyed kyi lha sgom pa'i ting nge 'dzin nam/ yang de nyid 'dus par/ de nas rdo rje kun dngos ni/ /snying gar yongs su sgom par bya/ /zhes dang / lce la rdo rje dge sgom nas/ /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ las rgya lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sna tshogs du rtse bcu gnyis pa re re/ chos rgya la lkog ma'i phyogs su pad 'dab la zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa chur nyal ba'i lte ba la lha rang rang gi sngags bkod/ dam rgya dang phyag chen dus lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re bsam pa ste/ 'od zer las dngos su ma bshad/ snying po dang sngags ni 'od zer gyi dgongs pa/ lha rang rang gi sngags brjod ces gsungs pa ltar so sor mi bzhed/ byin gyis brlabs pa dang / 'od zer las/ lag pa byin gyis brlabs la/ rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgya bstan zhes gsungs pas/ lag pa dang sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs pas bstan/

dbang bskur ba/ 'od zer las dngos su ma bshad kyang / sbyong rgyud tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i thad du/ rje btsun chen po'i mchan las/ rang gi lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang / ras bris la brten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa sbyin sreg gi sdig pa sbyang ba'i thabs kyi bye brag la sogs pa sngar bstan pa dang / phyis ston pa'i ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du/ zhes gsungs pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang zhes pas/ mdun bskyed la dbang bskur ba bstan cing / snying po dang snye ma sogs las gsal bar gsungs/ rigs pa ni sngags bzlas pa ste/ 'og bdag 'jug tshar rjes/ 'od zer las/ dkyil 'khor la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bag tsam gcig byas zhes gsungs pas kha bskang / mchod pa ni dngos su bshad/ des na phyag rgya ma gtogs sgrub pa'i yan lag gzhan rnams skabs 'dir dod tsam tshang ba 'dug lags kyang / nges par skabs 'dir yan lag bcu drug tshang dgos pa ni/ ci nas kyang ma yin gsungs pa gda' lags shing / slob dpon kun snying gis de nyid snang chen las kyang / rnam snang sogs lha re re zhing so sor sgrub na/ bsgrub pa'i yan lag bcu drug dgos la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams sgrub nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pas chog par gsungs te/ de nyid las/ snying po dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags dang rig pa'o/ /'di dag ni rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa re re zhing so sor sgrub par bya ba'i phyir gsungs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams sgrub pa na phyag rgya bzhi bzhir bstan pa nyid ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya zhes bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na yang / nges par sbyor dgos pa yin no/ /lugs gnyis pa ni mkhas mchog bu ston rin po che la sogs pa'i dam pa du ma zhal mthun par/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs 'dir sgrub pa'i yan lag bcu drug pa 'di dag nges par tshang dgos shing /

phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs kyang phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab rgyas pa la/ lha re la yang phyag rgya bzhi bzhis rgyas 'debs shing / bzhi so so re re la yang / lus kyi bca' ba/ ngag gi brjod pa/ yid kyi bsam pa ste/ bcu gnyis bcu gnyis yod do/ rgyas pa dgos kyi/ bsdus pas go mi chod gsungs shing / /rgyas par bu ston rin po che'i kun rig gi cho ga dang / rin chen 'phreng mdzes sogs na gsal bas 'dir bri mi dgos pa 'dug lags/ dri ba nyer gnyis pa/ kun rig gzhung rkyang sgrub mchod la/ /ras bris nges par dgos lags sam/ /dgos na rje btsun chen po yis/ /dkyil 'khor dbye ba so drug sogs/ /gsungs pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar yin/ /mi dgos de nyid ras bris la/ /med mi rung du byed pa ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir dkyil 'khor la dbye na/ 'jam dpal gyi bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ dkyil 'khor don la rnam gnyis te/ /chos nyid don gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /rgya chen rtags kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyis las/ dang po'i dbang du byas na/ zla gsang thig le las/ yan lag thams cad sgom las 'das/ /rtog dang mi rtog kun spangs pa/ /bden dang tshig las yang dag 'das/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor mchog ces bya/ /zhes dang / sbyong rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs gyur pa'i/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pas/ chos nyid skye 'gag med pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba dkyil 'khor du bshad pa 'di gang zag dbang po yang rab la dgongs so/ /gnyis pa rgya chen rtags kyi dkyil 'khor la dbye na/ slob dpon klu yi byang chub kyis/ /slob ma'i don du grub bya'i phyir/ /'khor lo rnam brgyad bri bar bya/ /rin chen de bzhin sa bon dang / /me tog tshon dang de bzhin du/ /bye ma g.yo dang phye ma ste/

/de bzhin yid kyi dkyil 'khor bden/ /zhes dkyil 'khor brgyad du dbye ba la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshad pas/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa med cing / yang gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi dbang du byas te/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ /dbye ba gzugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /ting 'dzin rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gsum/ /zhes dang / chos spyod bcu'i mdor yang / gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor bzhengs su gsol ba dang / ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor yid kyis sgom pa dang / rang bzhin dkyil 'khor gnas nas spyan 'dren pa zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /dbang po rab la sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor/ 'bring rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan 'dren pa'i dkyil 'khor/ tha ma gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor gsum las/ ding sang dbang po tha ma'i dbang du byas te/ nges par bris mi dgos kyang / kun rig sgrub mchod gzhung rkyang la dmigs pa'i rten ras bris sam/ lugs ma'am me tog tshom bu lta bu cig byas na legs te/ sbyong rgyud las/ gtso ri mo lugs mnga' 'ang rung / rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /ces dang / 'od zer las/ bris sku'am/ lugs ma'i drung du mchod pa dang gtor ma rgyas par bshams/ zhes dang / shin tu bsdus pa la dga' bas ni ras bris dang lugs ma la ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ zhes gsungs so/ /des na rje btsun chen pos gzhan phan spyi chings su/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis la/ /rdul tshon gyi rdul tshon byed na che chung gi chad/ gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ rgyal po khru ni brgya nyid dang / /de bzhin khru ni lnga bcu nyid/ /slob dpon tshong dpon ded dpon gyi/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'am de yi phyed/ /khru ni de dag ma nus na/ /ci nus par ni bri bar bya/ /zhes bshad/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis te/

/dkyil 'khor so drug tu phye te gsungs pa yang / /dbang po rab la ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor/ /'bring la rdul tshon/ tha ma ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa de lta bu la dgongs so/ /spyir yang cho ga 'di dag gang zag dmigs pa can gyi ngor gsungs pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ yul dus mtshan ma la sogs pa/ /mun pa'i sgrib pa rnams 'dod de/ /de dag bzung bar bya ba'i phyir/ /cho ga 'di yang brjod pa yin/ /zhes dang / sems can dag gi blo gzhan cing / /bya ba tsub gyis rmongs pa dag /dngos po'i don la chags pa rnams/ /ma 'ong dus na 'byung 'gyur te/ /'di lta'i tshul ni mi shes pas/ /yul dang dus dang bya ba las/ /dge dang mi dge'i mtshan ma yis/ /rmongs pa 'bras bu 'dod byed de/ /sems dpa' chen po de dag phyir/ /cho ga 'di ni brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na/ gang zag dmigs pa can rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ dmigs gtad dang bral ba'i dbang po dang rtogs pa rab kyi gang zag rnams kyis kyang / dmigs rten tsam re bcas nas cho ga byas na rang gzhan bsod nams 'phel ba zhig yod pa 'dra lags/ dri ba nyer gsum pa/ bstod ring phyag chen 'cha' ba 'di/ /sbyong rgyud dgongs pa yin lags sam/ /yin na rgyud tshig gang gis bstan/ /min na rtsa bshad gang nas bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ sbyong rgyud du dbyangs snyan pa'i bstod dang / zhes pa tsam las bstod pa'i tshig gang gis bstod kyang gsal bar bshad pa med pas/ phyag chen 'cha' ba ni sbyong rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin no/ /ding sang bstod ring la phyag chen mdzad pa 'di/ rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus par/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa la phyag chen dang bcas te bstod par gsungs te/ de nyid las/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /phyag rgya chen po sgom byed cing / /mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad dam pa ni/ /lan cig tu ni brjod par bya/

/zhes gsungs la/ de'i rigs pas/ rigs lnga yum bzhi sgeg sogs rnams la yang sbyar te mdzad par gda'/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ sbyong rgyud las/ dbyangs snyan pa'i bstod dang lha rdzas kyi/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces bstod pa yang mchod pa'i khongs su bsdus la/ rin chen 'bar ba las/ bcom ldan yon tan rab brjod pa/ /'di yang mchod pa'i yan lag yin/ /zhes pas/ bsten pa yang mchod pa'i yan lag tu bshad la/ mchod pa de la yang / rdo rje rtse mo las/ mchod pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ /rigs sngags mngon par bzlas brjod dang / /phyag rgya bcings ba lhur len dang / /rnal 'byor sgom pa'i mchod pa dang / /sgrub pa dag gis mchod pa 'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bstod pa'i tshig brjod pa rigs sngags bzlas pa'i mchod pa/ phyag chen 'cha' ba phyag rgya'i mchod pa/ de'i tshe lha rang rang gi sku gsal 'debs pa rnal 'byor sgom pa'i mchod pa/ de las rang gzhan gyis don 'grub par bsam pa sgrub pa'i mchod pa ste/ bzhi po tshang dgos pa'i phyir yang / phyag chen 'cha' ba mdzad pa yin pa gda' lags/ dri ba nyer bzhi pa/ cha gsum phyogs skyong bcu la sogs/ /'khor yug lha ru mi 'dus sam/ /'dus na skabs 'dir spyan 'dren ci/ /mi 'dus yid ches lung zin gang / /zhes gsungs pa/ 'di la bzhed lugs gnyis kyis/ dang po ni/ bu ston rin po che la sogs pa'i mkhas pa du ma'i bzhed pas/ phyogs skyong la sogs pa'i gtor mgron gyi yul 'di rnams/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug gi lha ru mi 'dus par bzhed/ legs grub kyi rgyud las/ khang pa'i phyi rol 'khor yug tu/ /lha rnams kun dang 'byung po yi/ /gtor ma gus pas dbul bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / kun snying gi sgyu dra'i 'grel par/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas phyi rol du phyung la/ bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig phyogs bcu nas 'ong ba'i sems can mi snang ba thams cad la/

phyogs kyi gtor ma ji lta ba bzhin du 'byin te/ zhes gsungs pa dang / rdo rje 'byung bar/ phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs dang / dpal mchog stod 'grel las/ phyi rol du gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis gtor ma dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du gtong bar gsungs la/ 'khor yug gi lha ni dkyil 'khor gyi nang na yod pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gtor ma 'bul ba'i mgron gang yin snyam na/ rnam snang sgyu dra'i 'grel par/ bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig phyogs bcu nas 'ong pa'i sems can mi snang ba thams cad la phyogs kyi gtor ma yin zhes gsungs pa dang / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil chog las/ /gang du bcom ldan dang lhan cig /'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams/ /gang yang rjes su 'brang las 'dir/ /gnas pa de dag thams cad rnams/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ ye shes pa'i phyi 'breng gi bgegs rnams la 'bul ba yin lags/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug gi lha rnams ni/ ngo bo 'das pa yin kyang / gdul bya'i dbang gis rnam pa 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba yin te/ slob dpon ka ma la dha nu'i sbyong rgyud kyi 'grel par/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi skabs su/ 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis byin rlabs pas cung zad dman par brjod pa'am/ yang na 'di dag ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'jig rten par gnang yang 'jig rten las 'das pa nyid do/ /'phags pa de kho na nyid 'dus par/ e ma ho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thabs ni snying rje'i bdag nyid de/ /gang du thabs kyis 'dul mdzad na/ /lha rnams su yang 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / rgyud gzhan las kyang / gang dang gang gi gzugs kyis ni/ /lus can rnam par 'dul gyur pa/ /thugs rje non pa de dang der/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid ston par mdzad/ /ces gsungs so/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyi rol gsungs lags/ bzhed lugs gnyis pa ni/

kun ting nam mkha' bzang po/ rong ston shes bya kun rig la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pas/ cha gsum gyi phyogs skyong la sogs pa'i gtor mgron 'di rnams/ 'jig rten 'khor yug gi lha tshogs 'di dag la ka 'bul ba yin gyi/ kun rig gi skabs 'dir/ gtor mgron gzhan mi dgos gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ sbyong rgyud las/ gling bzhi po na gang gnas pa/ dzam bu gling du tshangs pa che/ /zhes sogs nas/ shing dang kun dga' nags tshal sogs/ /dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa rnams/ /zhes pa'i bar du 'dzin pa kho nar bshad pa dang / 'od zer las kyang / 'das pa'i lha la mchod pa dang / /'jig rten pa la gtor ma sbyin pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i/ 'jig rten pa yang 'khor yug gi lha tshogs la dgongs pa yin no/ /gal te 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs ni/ rnam pa 'jig rten pa yin kyang ngo bo 'das pa yin no snyam na/ de ltar na/ sbyong rgyud las/ khro bo ma rung tshe ba yi/ /bgegs chen bi na ya ka rnams/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sems can la 'tshe ba'i bgegs ma rung pa rnams kyang / 'jig rten las 'das par 'dod na ha cang thal ba dang / sems can bkres shing skoms pas gdungs pa dang / /zhes gsungs pas/ rigs drug dang khyad par yid dwags kyi gtor ma bstan la/ de dag ster ba'i mgron kyang / brgya byin gtogs 'dod thams cad kyang / /'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya/ /zhes pas lha dang / lha min/ zhes pas lha ma yin dang / 'byung po yid dwags 'dre rnams dang / /zhes pas yid dwags/ klu dang / zhes sogs kyis dud 'gro dang / 'bru 'grel las/ klu ni byol song gi rigs te/ /zhes gsungs la/ khro ba ma rung / zhes pas dmyal ba ste/ 'bru 'grel du/ khro bo ma rung pa dmyal ba ste zhes sogs gsungs pas/ mi ma gtogs rigs drug gzhan rnams 'jig rten 'khor yug gi lha tshogs la yod cing / de dag kyang ngo bo 'das par 'gyur la/ 'dod na sangs rgyas bkres skom gyis gdus pas 'dod dgos pas ha cang thal lo/

/'o na gtor ma 'jig rten 'khor yug la ster dgos na/ skabs 'dir spyan 'dren mi dgos te/ sngar du spyan drangs zin pa'i phyir ro/ /snyam na bden mod/ spyir cha gsum gyi gtor ma 'di dag kun rig gi cho ga'i skabs su bya ba dang / cho ga'i skabs gzhan du byed pa gnyis las/ snga ma ltar na spyan 'dren mi dgos kyang / phyi ma ltar na spyan 'dren dgos pas/ ding sang spyan 'dren byed pa ni/ chos 'di nyid kyi skabs gzhan du byed pa la dgongs nas/ spyan 'dren gyi tshig 'di dag dkyus su bcug pa mdzad la/ de'i lag len kun rig gi cho ga'i skabs su 'chug pa yin gyis ma byas kyang 'dir cho ga chad par mi 'gyur la/ gzhan du ma byas na cho ga chad pa'i skyon du 'gyur gsungs par gda' lags/ de ltar bzhed pa de gnyis las/ kun rig gi cho ga'i skabs su phyi ma nyid 'thad par nges shing / gzhan yang 'di dag la dpyad pa dang rnam par dpyad pa mang du 'dug na'ang / mangs su dogs nas ma bris pa yin lags/ dri ba nyer lnga pa/ 'jug pa'i skabs su sbyong rgyud las/ /'di yi me tog la sogs dor/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs khong ji ltar yin/ zhes gsungs pa la/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa'i sogs khong ni/ /rin po che dor ba 'don pa yin te/ sbyong rgyud kun rig las/ me tog rin chen la sogs des brgyan la/ /g.yon gyi lag pa bkang te bzhugs par bya/ /zhes dang / me tog rin chen la sogs pa/ /gang la babs pa rigs kyi lha/ /zhes dang / phyag rdor skabs las/ lag na rin chen thogs te bzhug /yang na me tog phreng ba ste/ /de ni dkyil 'khor nyid du dor/ /zhes dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i skabs las/ me tog rin chen thogs te bzhugs/ zhes dang / de nas me tog gi rin chen 'di dor bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs las/ lag na rin chen thogs te bzhugs/ zhes gsungs gda' lags/ yang bla ma gong ma la la/ sogs khong nas dar sngon dmar me tog gi phreng ba lnga dang bcas pa yin gsungs pa'ang gda' lags/

dri ba nyer drug pa/ 'jug pa spangs nas dbang bskur na/ /don dang tshig la 'gal ba ci/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir rgyud kyis dgongs pa/ sngar dbang ye ma bskur ba zhig gi dbang du mdzad nas/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad la 'jug pa mdzad nas dbang bskur ba kho na gsungs la/ gzhan phan 'od zer du/ sngar dbang ma thob pa'i dbang du mdzad nas 'jug pa dang bcas te dbang bskur gsungs/ yang sngar dbang bskur lan gcig gam gnyis tsam song ba'i dbang du mdzad de/ 'od zer las/ 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bdag 'jug ni/ /rigs lnga'i sdom pa blangs pa la bsdus la/ /slob ma la bya ba dbang bskur bas sdig pa sbyangs ba nas bzung ste/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba la bsdus te dbang bskur bar gsungs shing / yang sngar dbang bskur yang yang song ba'i dbang du mdzad de/ 'od zer las/ 'jug pa ci grub dang dbang ngam/ 'jug pa ma grub kyang dbang tsam grub kyang bzang der 'di ltar bya'o/ /'di ni legs par bris pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'jug pa'i chos rnams spangs te/ dbang kho na bskur bas rung bar gsungs gda' lags/ dri ba nyer bdun pa/ bdun brgyud rigs kyi grangs nges la/ /'phags pa brgyad stong bka' gdam dang / /rnam 'byed me tog phreng rgyud sogs/ /dgongs pa mi mthun rang lugs gang / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'di dag kyang / dpung bzang las/ rang gi bu med mdza' bshes gnyen bdun dang / /zhes dang / khyad par 'phags bstod las/ thub pa khyod kyi gnyen 'dun dge /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ nye du bdun rgyud kyi ngos 'dzin yin te/ 'phags pa brgyad stong par/ khyod kyi ming 'di zhes bya/ khyod kyi ma'i ming 'di zhes bya/ khyod kyi pha'i ming 'di zhes bya/ de bzhin du grogs po dang / blon po dang / gnyen bshes dang / snag gi gnyen tshan gyi ming 'di zhes bya'o/ zhes ma mes dang / pha mes gnyis ka'i bdun brgyud tshun chad kyi ming brjod cing /

zhes gsungs te/ pha'i phyogs kyi bdun brgyud dang / /ma'i phyogs kyi bdun brgyud gnyis su phye la/ bka' gdam pha chos kyi le'u nyer gcig par/ yang yum ma dang / sring mo dang / ma'i ma dang / ma'i spun zla sogs pa nye bar bdun tshun chad dang / de bzhin du pha'i ma dang / nye du bdun tshun chad la mi bya ba dang / de bzhin du bud med kyi rigs de dag gis kyang / pha dang ming po dang khu bo dang / mes po la sogs pa dang / bdun brgyud las lhag pa la 'dod pa'i yul dang chags sems kyi yul mi bya zhes gsungs te/ 'dir yang ma'i phyogs kyi bdun brgyud dang / pha'i phyogs la pho dang mo'i bdun brgyud gnyis su phye'o/ /'dul ba thun mong ba pha'i rnam 'byed las/ phyi mo dang / mes po dang / phrugs las brten pa'i bdun brgyud tshun chad nye du yin la/ de phan chad ni nye du ma yin no zhes gsungs te/ phyi mo ni ma'i ma yin la/ mes po ni pha'i pha dang / phrugs las brten pa ni pha dang ma yin la/ de la brten pa'i bdun pa tshun chad ni nye du yin no/ /dgra bcom pa sa ga lhas mdzad pa'i 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud las/ ma dang pha dang ma'i pha/ /nye bar bzung nas bdun brgyud ni/ /mkhyen brtse khyed kyis nye dur gsungs/ /de las gzhan ni gnyen min nyid/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang dang / ma dang / pha dang / ma'i pha dang / pha'i pha dang / bu dang / tsha bo la sogs pa nye du yin la/ de phan chad nye du min zhes pa ste/ de ltar bdun brgyud la ngos 'dzin lugs mang du gda' na'ang 'dir ni/ rgyud las/ rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /bdun brgyud rigs ni brlag par mdzad/ /ces gsungs te/ sgrub pa po'i dam tshig ma bsrung na khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin pa phyag na rdo rje khros nas gang zag sgrub pa po dam tshig nyams pa de nyid/ skye ba bdun gyi bar du rigs dang bral te ngan song gsum pa sogs brlag par mdzad/ ces pa sgrub pa po de nyid kyi skye ba bdun la bdun brgyud ces gsungs pa yin la/

'jam ṭika tu/ rang gi slob bu'i rus mar la ded pa'i bdun brgyud tshun chad zhes bshad kyang / ma nges te/ slob ma med pa dang / rus chad pa'i gang zag dam tshig nyams pa srid pa'i phyir ro/ /yang snur pa/ rang ma gtogs yar gyi bdun brgyud la 'dod de/ gong ma gcig grol ba'ang srid pas mi 'thad/ ces rje btsun chen po gsung / gal te bdun brgyud rigs zhes gsungs pas nye du bdun brgyud yin no snyam na yin te/ sgrub pa po'i dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes dmigs rang la 'byung ba rigs kyi/ nye du la 'byung ba mi rigs pa dang / khyad par 'phags bstod las/ bram ze rnams ni dge sdig dag /sbyin pa len bzhin pho bar smra/ /khyod kyi byas chud mi 'dza' dang / /ma byas pa dang 'phrad med gsungs/ /ces gsungs pas rang gi byas pa'i dge sdig gi 'bras bu gzhan las 'pho bar 'dod pa mu stegs kyi lugs yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi ni rang gi las byas pa chud mi 'dza' ba dang / las ma byas pa gzhan la smin par ma gsungs te/ mdo las/ dge slong mau'u 'gal gyis bus las byas pa ni/ sa la yang mi smin/ chu la yang mi smin/ mau'u 'gal gyi bu nyid la smin no zhes gsungs pa dang / rnal 'byor ma ne gu mas/ rgur chung tshe stod tshe smad dang / /ces gsungs pa'i dgram bcom pa/ rgur chung gi gtam rgyud kyang nges par bya'o/ /de ltar ma yin na/ sgrub pa po rgyud grol ba'i tshe/ nye du bdun tshun chad kyang rgyud grol bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang dam tshig nyams pa las/ nyams grib nye du ma zad gzhan la yang 'byung bar gsungs kyi/ dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes dmigs nye du la 'byung bar gsungs pa bdag gis ma mthong / nye du sogs kyidon du sdig pa byas pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu yang rang nyid la byung bar gsungs kyi/ nye du rnams la 'byung bar ma gsungs te/ bshes springs las/ khyod kyi bram ze dge slong lha dang ni/ /mgron dang yab yum dag dang btsun mo dang /

/'khor gyi slad du sdig pa mi bgyid ste/ /dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sdig pa'i rnam smin gyi 'bras bu rang nyid la 'byung gi gzhan gyis skal ba 'khur ba ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de na bdun brgyud rigs brlag par gsungs pa yang / dam tshig nyams pa'i skye bo de nyid kyis skye ba bdun brgyad tshun chad yin gyi/ nye du bdun brgyud la de'i nyes pa 'byung bar 'dod pa ni/ rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin pa 'dra lags/ dri ba nyer brgyad pa/ bum pa la sogs dbang bcu la/ /re re'ang lnga lngar 'byed pa yi/ /khyad chos zab khyad ji ltar yod/ /ces gsungs pa/ sbyong rgyud las/ bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs nas/ /bcu po rnams kyi dbang ni ci dgar bskur/ /zhes gsungs te/ bum pa'i dbang yang / mi bskyod pa'i mi bskyod pa/ mi bskyod pa'i rnam snang / mi bskyod pa'i rin 'byung sogs dang / cod paṇa dang / rin po che'i 'phreng ba dang / dar dpyang rnams/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rin chen 'byung ldan sogs lnga dang / phyag rgya'i dbang 'od dpag med rigs lnga dang / ming gi dbang rnam par snang mdzad rigs lnga dang / 'phrin las kyi dbang don grub rigs lnga dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dbang rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs lngas bskur ba yin la/ de dag kyang / sbyang gzhi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi zhe sdang sogs lnga/ ser sna'i ser sna sogs lnga/ 'dod chags kyi 'dod chags sogs lnga/ gti mug gi gti mug sogs lnga/ phrag dog gi phrag dog sogs lnga/ nyon mongs pa lnga spyir sbyangs pa dang / gsang ba'i dbang la yum dang yab kyi gsang ba'i dbang gnyis/ dang po la yum lnga dang / gnyis pa la yab lnga yod pa'i dbang gi phye ba yin nam snyam zhing / gzhan dbang bcu po re re la dbang lnga lngar phye ba'i khyad chos 'di yin zhes pa/ rgyud gzhung gong ma'i gsung rab las gsal bar gsungs pa ma mthong lags/

dri ba nyer dgu pa/ badz+ra dha ra'i nga rgyal la/ /nga rgyal bskyed la slob ma gzhug /ces sogs thub pa'i rgyud las gsungs/ /sgrub mchod gzhung yang byed pa'i tshe/ /nga rgyal 'dzin pa mi dgos sam/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'di la rgyud dang rje btsun chen po'i dgongs pa lugs gsum gyis/ dang po ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra sogs kyi sngags 'di/ tshe dpag med gsung dkyil gyi skabs nas gsungs la/ gzhan phan spyi chings su/ 'jug pa'i skabs su rigs lnga'i nga rgyal bskyed pa gcig tshe dpag med las 'byung ste/ de nyid kyi cho ga khyad par ba yin no/ zhes gsungs pas/ 'jug pa'i skabs su rigs lnga'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa/ tshe dpag gsung dkyil gyi khyad chos yin par gsungs pas/ nga rgyal 'dzin pa 'di kun rig sogs dkyil 'khor gzhan bcu ga la mi dgos pa 'dug lags/ lugs gnyis pa/ rgyud las/ sngags mkhan bdag nyid zhugs la/ zhes pa nas/ de nas bdag nyid dbang bskur te/ /zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon bdag 'jug tshar ba'i rjes su/ rgyud las/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra/ rat+na dha ra sogs nas/ at+ma ko3haṃ zhes pas nga rgyal bskyed la/ slob ma rnams gzhug par bya'o/ /zhes slob dpon rigs lnga'i nga rgyal bskyed nas slob ma rnams 'jug cing dbang bskur bar gsungs pa dang / gzhan phan 'od zer las kyang / de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ rang nyid rigs lnga so so'am/ gtso bo'am/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal dran pas/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra nas/ ko3haṃ zhes nga rgyal brtan par byas la/ da gdod slob ma'i bya ba la 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ slob dpon rigs lnga'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa ste/ /de yang slob ma la dbang bskur na sngon du nga rgyal 'dzin dgos kyi/ dbang mi bskur na/ sgrub mchod gzhung rkyang gi bdag gi tshe yang nga rgyal 'dzin mi dgos so/ /'ga' zhig slob ma la dbang mi bskur kyang /

bdag 'jug tshar rjes sngags 'di brjod nas nga rgyal 'dzin par byed pa ni/ rgyud dang rje btsun gyi dgongs pa ma yin pas ma 'thad do/ /nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i sngags 'di la yang / shar pa rdo rje 'od zer gyi kun rig gi cho ga nyi ma'i 'od zer du/ oṃ badz+ra dha ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ badz+ra sa ma ya dha ra at+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ rat+na dha ra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ rat+na sa ma ya dha ra at+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin du/ pad+ma dha ra/ bi sho dha ra/ oṃ ta thā ga ta dha ra gsum ka la/ sa ma ya man chad btags la/ rigs lnga'i nga rgyal gyi slob ma gzhug ces 'byung la/ 'di rje btsun chen pos/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal 'dzin par gsungs pas/ sngags 'di bzhin gyis rigs lnga'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa legs pa 'dra zhing / slob ma dbang bskur ba'i sngon du/ slob dpon rigs lnga'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa 'di/ /mkhas grub du ma'i bzhed par gda'/ /lugs gsum pa ni/ slob ma rigs lnga'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa ste/ rgyud las/ zhes nga rgyal bskyed la zhes pa'i mchan du/ rje btsun chen pos/ slob ma rnams rigs lnga'i ngo bor nga rgyal bskyed la/ zhes gsungs shing / de'i lag len ni/ gzhan phan snying po sogs las bdag 'jug gi rgyun bshags kyi sngon du/ sngags 'di brjod nas rigs lnga'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa mdzad la/ lugs 'di nyid ltar na kun rig gi cho ga gzhung rkyang la yang / bdag 'jug dus nga rgyal 'dzin dgos pa 'dug lags/ des na lugs de gsum gang rung gcig byas pas 'gal ba mi yong pa gda' lags/ dri ba sum cu pa/ lho sgo'i skabs su ming byang la/ /'phan gdugs pad+ma 'bri ba la/ /lung rig yid ches ji ltar yod/ /ces gsungs pa/ 'di la mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gsungs pas/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ lho sgo yi ni sa yi char/ /khru gang pa la gru bzhi pa/ /stegs bu legs par brtsigs nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pas/ stegs bu khru gang pa de dbang stegs yin/ yang de nyid las/

de nas de yi cha ru ni/ /sngar bshad pa yis rim pa yi/ /pad+ma dkar po la gnas pa'i/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mdzes pa bris/ /de la slob ma bzhag nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gdan pad+ma dang 'khor lo yin pas/ pad+ma 'bri ba gdan yin/ gsang ba rgyan bkod kyi rgyud las/ bzang po'i seṅge'i khri bzhag dang / /dbang bskur ba yi sbyor ba bya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /mdzes pa'i rnga yab g.yob pa bzhag /zhes dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ so so'i khri 'i steng du ni/ /dar dang me tog chun pos spras/ /dkar po gdugs dang rin po che/ /bla bre rgya che 'bar ba dang / /zhes gsungs pas/ 'phan gdugs rnams 'bri ba de la mchod pa mtshon pa'i phyir yin gsungs la/ yang mkhas pa la la dag gsungs bas/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ lho sgo'i cho ga bya ba ni/ /stegs bu khru gang rnams lngas byug /tsan+dan dkar po'i maṇ+ḍal la/ /bum pa rdzas bcas me tog dgram/ /mtshon bya gdug dang smyug ma dang / /thugs kyi mda' lnga 'phros pa yis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ stegs bu ni sbyang stegs yin/ me tog ni gdan/ mtshon bya ni ming byang / gdugs ni de la mchod pa mtshon/ /mdor na sbyong ba'i rten ming byang de la bar do'i shes pa chags shing 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod/ smyug ma gzhan du longs ma spyad pa zhig la ming byang 'dzugs te/ rnam shes bag chags kyi nyer len de skyon med smyug ma ye shes kyi don rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod/ gdugs dang dar dpyangs la sogs pas ming byang mdzes par brgyan pa de/ skyabs dang brten pa lta bur mthong nas/ nyams dga' ba dang shes pa chags pa'i dgos pa yod gsungs pa gda' lags/ dri ba so gcig pa/ rnam shes dgug gzhug phyag rgya sngags/ /sbyong rgyud nang na gsal lags sam/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rnam shes dgug pa'i phyag rgya dang sngags 'di rnams/ sbyong rgyud rgyas pa na mi gsal zhing / gzhan phan spyi chings su/

rgyud 'di na med pa rnam par shes pa dgug pa la sogs pa'i phyag len mdzad pa ni/ de nyid 'dus pa dang / khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa'i gzhung gis dpang po byas nas bstan pa yin no zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa gda' lags shing / gzhan phan 'od zer las/ phyag rgya khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang / sngags oṃ trag ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes pas mdzad/ gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag rgya yis/ /sdig pa'i phung po dgug par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yin zhing / bu ston rin po ches phyag rgya gsang ba'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang / sngags oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas mdzad/ de nyid 'dus par/ shi ba'i rnam par shes pa 'gugs snying po 'di nyid thugs ka nas byung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas de'i phyag rgya bcings ba bshad do/ /gsang ba'i lcags kyu gdams byas te/ /mtha' ma mnyam du brkyangs byas la/ /shi ba'i mgo bor bzhag nas ni/ /srog ni slar yang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs par gda'/ de'i dus kyi dmigs pa yang / /mtshan brjod kyi ro bsreg las/ de yi shes pa rlung lta bu/ /srin bu me khyer ltar bkug ste/ /kha dog dbyibs su gsal ba las/ /bar du gcod pa'i bgegs bsal te/ /rten de nyid la gzhug par bya/ /zhes dang / gsang 'dus dus tha ma'i cho gar ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes/ snying kha'i sa bon las ni grub pa bzang / /'khor los mtshan pa'i lcags kyu spro bar bya/ /de yi gshin po 'jig rten pha rol song / /sems ni mdog dmar gsal ba dgug bya ste/ /chos kyi sgo mo'i gzugs sam yang na ni/ /rlung med me mi g.yo ba lta bu 'o/ /'ong nas de yi shes pa snying kar ni/ /ro yi spyi bo nas ni gzhug par bya/ /zhes dang / gtsug dgu las/ de nas 'od kyi snang ba yis/ /ngan 'gror gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /sngags kyi 'od kyis bkug nas ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas bral bar bya/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa gda' lags/ dri ba so gnyis pa/ rdzas gcig til gyi sbyin sreg 'di/ /rtsa bshad rgyud sde gang las bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ spyir sbyong rgyud dang / gzhan phan 'od zer las/ sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyang ba la/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyangs ltar/ rdzas gcig po til gyi sbyin sreg 'di ma bshad/ dus tha ma'i cho ga gzhan phan bdud rtsir yang 'di ma gsungs pas/ ma byas kyang 'gal ba med cing / yang bla ma rnams phyag len la mdzad gyin gda' ba/ zhes kyang mdzad na lugs gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ rab gnas kyi rgyud las/ de nas de la sngags 'di yis/ /me dang de nas chu la ste/ /oṃ sarba pa paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes gsungs slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ de'i sems kyi rten la ni/ /sdig pa'i gzugs kyis phyung nas ni/ /rna ba'i bu gar 'thon nas ni/ /til la thim zhing bsreg par bsam/ /zhes gsungs/ pa la brten nas/ til la sdig pa'i phung por gyur pa/ chu dang me la dor bar mdzad de/ phyag len phal cher 'di la slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i dus mtha' mar yang bshad/ mdzad/ lugs gnyis pa ni/ bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /sgrub bya'i rkang pa dag pa ni/ /gzhu yi rnam 'dra'i dkyil 'khor te/ /lte bar ye shes yang dag 'bar/ /de yis snying khar 'bar ba yi/ /'od zer 'bar ba kun du 'khrigs/ /bsam byung sdig pa mi zad pa/ /sna yi sgo nas phyung nas ni/ /de nas khro bo'i gzugs sgom ste/ /kun tu zos pa bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ bu ston rin po che la sogs pa/ me nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskyed nas/ til la sdig pa bstim pa de khro bo'i zhal du gsol bar bsam nas sbyin sreg mdzad/ lugs gsum pa ni/ de nyid 'dus pa las/ bud shing dang po rnams kyi mes/ /rab sbar rdo rje mkha' 'gro yis/

/mnyam par bzhag pa snyoms zhugs la/ /til bsregs pas ni sdig bsregs shing / /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ thab nang du rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed nas/ til 'bul ba sogs kyi phyag len 'di/ nyi thog pa kun dga' zla ba dang / rdzong bu lo tsā ba la sogs pas mdzad par gda' lags/ dri ba so gsum pa/ phyi+ir bzlog chos pa'i dngos tshig gang / /zhes gsungs pa 'di la yang / mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa lugs gsum gyi/ dang po ni/ las dang nyon mongs pa las phyir/ /phyir bzlog cho ga zhes pa ste/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ las dang nyon mongs phyir bzlog pa'i/ /yungs kar sngags kyis brten par bya/ /ming ngam rus bu rus la brabs/ /zhes gsungs 'dug lags/ lugs gnyis pa ni/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gsungs pas/ ngan 'gro nas bde 'gror bzlog par byed pa'i cho ga yin pas/ phyir bzlog ces bya ste/ sbyong rgyud las/ de ltar byas na sdig can yang / /ngan song gnas nas thar 'gyur zhes/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / de nyid 'dus par/ ngan 'gro dgug cing sdig pa bral/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs par bzhed/ lugs gsum pa ni/ sbyong rgyud kun rig gi skabs las/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i sgo bdun du gsungs/ go rim kyang / dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyong ba/ bzlas pa'iྎ sbyin sreg giྎ ro sreg teྎ mchod rten gdab pa'iྎ ro sogs rten med na ji ltar bya ba'iྎ phyir bzlog gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyangs ba rnams rim gyis bstan la/ lag len la/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba las go rim phyir bzlog pas na phyir bzlog gi cho ga zhes pa ste/ 'od zer las/ lag len ni/ sngon la rten bskyed/ bskyed pa nas bzlas pa dang / phyir bzlog gi sbyangs nas/ 'dod dbang bskur bar byed la/ 'dir kun rig gi gzhung ma 'khrugs par byed na sngon la 'jug pa dang dbang rdzogs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs par/ dam pa kha cig bzhed par gda' lags/

dri ba so bzhi pa/ phyir bzlog skabs su chu gtsang la/ /sngags btab gtor na rung lags sam/ zhes gsungs pa ni/ 'dir bye ma'am/ yungs kar ram/ thal ba'am/ me tog gam/ 'bras bu rnams la sngags btab nas brab pa dang / chu'i bkru bar gsungs pa las/ /chu la sngags btab nas btor bar gsungs pa ma mthong lags/ de yang sbyong rgyud las/ thal ba yungs kar bye ma sogs/ /rang gi ming smos sngags btab nas/ /bzlas pa byas te brabs nas kyang / /zhes gsungs la/ de'i sogs khong nas/ rje btsun chen po'i mchan las/ 'bru sna zhes gsungs/ yang de nyid las/ chu mchog gis ni bkrus nas ni/ /bzlas pa dri yis byug par bya/ /zhes dang / gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog las/ de nas phyir bzlog bya ba ni/ /yungs kar gyis ni bya ba yin/ /yung dkar me tog dang ldan pas/ /sngags rnams bzlas shing brdeg par bya/ /rus pa'am gos sam ming la ni/ /de rjes chu yis bkru bar bya/ /zhes dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ yungs kar sngags kyis brdeg par bya/ /ming ngam rus bu rus la brabs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / slob dpon skal bzang dga' bas/ thal ba'am/ yungs kar ram/ bye ma'am/ dri la shi ba'i ming dang zhes gsungs pa rnams kyis/ yungs kar sogs kyis brab pa dang / /chu yis bkru bar gsungs/ gzhan yang / rnam rgyal gyi gzungs las/ sems can sdig pa byed pa gang dag shi ba'i dus byas pa de dag gi don du/ gzungs 'di yungs kar dag la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su brjod de/ de dag gi rus gong rnams kyi steng du gtor na/ de dag sems can dmyal ba'am/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas sam zhes sogs dang / gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs las/ gzungs 'di bye ma la lan nyi shu rtsa cig bzlas brjod byas te/ dur khrod du gtor na gang gi rus pa la phog pa de dag zhes sogs dang / don zhags kyi cho ga zhib mo las sems can gang la la dmyal bar gzhol ba shi ba dang / dge slong gang la bslab pa'i sdom pa dang tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ral ba dang /

mkhan po dang slob dpon la gus pa ma byas pa shi ba de'i don du/ bye ma gtsang ma blangs la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas dur khrod dam/ ro bsregs pa'am/ 'chad pa der bye ma gtor bar bya'o zhes sogs kyang / yungs kar ram bye ma la sngags bzlas nas gtor bar gsungs so/ /'o na las kyi sgrib pa rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs las/ sa'am/ til lam/ yungs kar/ ram chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod byas te/ rus pa'am/ shi ba'i lus la gtor ram/ khrus byas nas de'i 'og tu bsregs pa'am/ 'chad pa'i nang du bcug ste bzhag la zhes sogs gsungs/ chu gang yang rung ba la bzlas brjod byas te zhes pas chu gtsang la sngags btab nas gtor ba bstan no snyam na ma yin te/ shi ba'i lus la gtor ram zhes pas/ sa til yungs gsum gtor ba bstan/ khrus byas nas zhes pas/ chus khrus byed pa bstan pa yin la/ de na chu gtsang la sngags btab nas ming byang ngam ro sogs la 'thor bar bshad pa ma mthong lags/ dri ba so lnga pa/ phar phyin drug gi sdig sbyangs la/ /bkru sngags badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ /bzlas pa rgyud sde gang las bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ni/ skabs 'dir/ gtsug dgu'i gzhung las/ sdig pa bkru ba'i sngags kyis ni/ /srid gsum dri ma bkru bar bya/ /bkru ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarbā dur ga ti zhes sogs rtsa rig yin par gsungs pa dang / gzhan pas 'od zer du yang bkru sngags rtsa rig tu gsungs 'dug lags/ yang bu ston rin po che la sogs pa bkru sngags bsdus pa rtsa rig la mdzad/ rgyas par na gtsug dgu'i rgyud las/ shi ba'i rus pa gos la rab bkru ba/ /oṃ shwa dha ni zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ srid gsum dri ma chu yis bkru bar bya/ /oṃ kaṃ ka ni zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ ba yi rnam pa lnga yis bkru bar bya/ /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne zhes sogs sngags kyis ni/ /dri bzang rnams ni kun gyis bkru bar bya/ /oṃ a mo gha a pa ra na sogs/

sngags kyis ba yi 'o mas bkru bar bya/ /oṃ a mi te a mi te zhes sogs/ sngags kyis chu mchog gis kyang bkru bar bya/ /oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye sogs kyis ni/ /bar dang bar du chu yis bkru bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdzad/ sngags 'di drug gi dang po/ kun rig gi skabs dang / phyi ma lnga/ phyag rdor thugs dkyil gyi skabs nas bshad/ yang phyag len 'ga' zhig la bkru sngags rgyas na rtsa rig dang / bsdus na oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ zhes pas mdzad pa 'di/ rgyud las bshad pa mi snang yang / 'dir bdag bskyed la rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom zhing / de'i nga rgyal gyis bya dgos pas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ zhes pa rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po yin pa la thugs rtse gtad pa 'dra lags shing / rnal 'byor bla med kyi skabs 'ga' zhig tu/ bkru sngags yi dam gang byed kyi sngags dang yi ge brgya pas byed par gsungs pas/ de'i tshul mtshungs yang yin pa gda' lags/ des na bkru sngags rgyas pa/ oṃ sho dha ni sogs sngags drug 'bring na rtsa rig bsdu na rdo rje sems dpa'i snying po byas pas yong ba gda' lags/ dri ba so drug pa/ bar do'i skabs su mdzod 'grel las/ byang chub sems dpa' gos dang bcas/ /dge slong dkar mo gos dang bcas/ /zhes gsungs byang sems mtshan nyid pa/ /yin na bar dor yong ba ci/ /dkar mo zhes pa'ang rgyu mtshan gang / /zhes gsungs pa/ 'dis byang chub sems dpa' 'di gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ mdzod 'grel las/ byang chub sems dpa' ni dper na gzhon nu thor gtsug mtshan dang dpe byad dang bcas pa yin no/ /de nyid kyi phyir srid pa ma la gnas pa yum gyi lhums su 'jug pa gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgyar snang bar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di skye mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' la dgongs pa/ gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya yang sprul sku'i zhing khams yin pa la dgongs so/ /gnyis pa ni mdzod 'grel las/ byang chub sems dpa' yang gos dang bcas yin no/

/zhes gsungs pa 'di'i skyabs kyi byang chub sems dpa' dang / bar dor yong ba skye ba lan gnyis gsum la sogs pa len dgos pa 'dra lags/ yang mdzod 'grel las/ dge slong ma dkar mo yang gos dang bcas pa yin no/ /smon lam gyi dbang gis de nyid kyi bkra shis nas bsreg pa'i bar du yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di la/ spyir dkar mo zhes pa kha dog la bzhag pa dang / ming la bzhag pa dang / gos dang bcas pa la bzhag pa dang / dri ma dang bral ba la bzhag pa dang bzhi las/ skabs 'dir phyi ma yin par mngon/ /de yang nyes ltung gi dri ma dang bral bas rang bzhin gyis dkar mo zhes btags pa yin snyam lags/ 'on kyang / mdzod slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ kyi 'grel pa/ 'grel bshad slob dpon gang spel dang rgyal sras ma dang / gnyis sogs las mi gsal bas/ rgyu mtshan nges dag rang 'bul du ma byung bas/ phyis nges par brtag 'tshal lags/ dri ba so bdun pa/ zas kyi ched du bsur bsngo pa/ yid ches lung zin ji ltar yod/ /ces gsungs pa/ 'di la sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang mi ldan pa'i/ zas dang / gos dang / btung ba dang / bzhon pa dang / rgyan dang / bsur bsngod pa la sogs pa la dgos pa ma mchis te/ tshe 'phos pa ji ltar 'gyur ba lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ kye rgyal po chen po/ rgyal po chen pos 'di nas shi 'phos pa la/ pha ma'am/ spun nam bu la sogs pa'i nye ris rnams kyis bza' ba dang / btung ba nyung ngu nyung ngur gtad pa dang / bsngos pa yang bskal pa mang por zad par mi 'gyur bar za zhing 'thung ngo zhes 'jig rten pa dag 'chi na de legs sam zhes gsungs pa ni/ kye rgyal po chen po/ gling bzhi pa nas stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / stong gnyis dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyis khams dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa dpag tu med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad na/ bza' ba dang / btung ba nyung ngu nyung ngus dus thams cad du bskal pa mang por za ba'i sems can gzigs sam/

gsan nam/ kye rgyal po chen po/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che la ci bsam pa'i 'dod pa 'byung ba 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la yod pa'ang / sngon bskal pa mang por bsod nams kyi tshogs tshad med pa bsags pa las byung ba yin no/ /gnam nas babs sam/ glo bur du byung ni ma yin na/ bza' ba dang btung ba nyung ngu de bskal pa'i mtha'i bar du mi zad pa de rigs lags sam/ kye rgyal po chen po/ tshe ma 'phos pa'i pha'u dang / /spun cig 'grel par 'dzin pa phan par 'dod pa rnams dang / da ltar ma shi ba lus dang ldan pa dag cig yul gzhan du song na/ de la pha ma'am/ bu'am/ spun gang yang rung bas zas skom mang po sbyin no/ /gsol lo zhes bsngos pa yang / yul gzhan du song ba'i rmi lam du yang mi 'byung na/ dngos por za zhing 'thung ba lta ga la yod/ tshe 'phos nas sems can lus dang bral ba des/ bu dang spun la sogs pas gtad pa'i zas dang skom dngos po can 'di dag sems can dngos po med pa gzugs med pas ji ltar bdag po byed par 'gyur/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bza' ba dang bca' ba ni lus yod pa'i yan lag gi rtsol ba la rag las na/ sems la lus kyi yan lag de rtsol ba yod dam/ rgyal po chen pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar na tshe 'phos pa las 'di nas phan 'dogs pa'i bza' btung dang bzhon pa dang gos dang rgyan gtod pa 'di la don ma mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po/ tshe 'phos pa des las gang spyad pa'i rnam par smin pas 'gro ba rigs tha dad pa gang du skye ba len pa de la/ mi dge ba dang ma 'brel ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs su gyur pa'i las dge ba sna tshogs pas btang na mtho ris dang thar par yang skye la/ gal te skye ba blangs pa zhig la bsod nams su 'gyur ba'i las dge ba zhig gi btang na/ skye ba blang pa der nor rnyed pa dang / lo legs pa dang / 'dod pa'i long spyod 'phel ba dang /

'gro ba gzhan thams cad kyis mchod cing bskur ba'i phan pa yod kyi/ tshe 'phos pa skye ba mi len pas gshin rje'i 'jig rten na yod na/ bza' btung dang / bzhon pa dang / gos dang / rgyan bdag por byed pa ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mdo 'di bsdus pa'i don la gnyis/ /'jig rten pa dag tshe 'phos pa la bza' gtad byed pa la longs spyod par 'dod pa'i tshul dang / de la dgos pa yod med zhus pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ zhus pa dang / lan no/ /dang po ni/ kye rgyal po chen po/ rgyal po chen pos/ zhes pa nas/ lags sam zhes pa'i bar ro/ /lan la gnyis te/ mi rigs pa'i dpe bstan pa dang / don bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mthong tsher med pa'i dpe/ 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal la yid bzhin gyi nor bu yod pa'i dpe/ mthong chos la sbyar ba'i dpe'o/ /dang po ni/ kye rgyal po chen po/ gling bzhi pa nas/ zhes pa nas/ gzigs sam/ gsan nam zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ kye rgyal po chen po/ yid bzhin gyis zhes pa nas/ de rigs la lags sam zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyal po chen po/ tshe ma 'phos pa'i pha'u zhes pa nas/ dngos por bza' zhing btung ba lta ga la yod zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa don bshad pa la gnyis/ tshe 'phos pa la gtad cing bsngos pa'i bza' btung mi 'byung bar bstan pa dang / de'i rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ tshe 'phos nas zhes pa nas/ lta ga la yod zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ tshe 'phos pa'i sems can dngos med yin cing zas skom dngos can yin par bstan pa dang / bza' btung lus dang yan lag gi rtsol ba la rag cing sems la rtsol ba med par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kye rgyal po chen po/ tshe 'phos nas sems can zhes pa nas/ ji ltar bdag po med par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni de ci'i phyir zhes pa nas/ rtsol ba yod dam zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa de la don yod med zhus pa gnyis/

zhus pa dang / lan no/ /dang po ni/ rgyal po chen pos gsol pa/ zhes pa nas/ don ma mchis lags sam/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /lan la gsum/ tshe 'phos pa bar do na yod pa la dge ba'i sems kyi bsam pas dge ba byas pa'i phan yon dang / skye ba blangs la dge ba byas pa'i phan yon dang / de'i phyir bar do na gnas pa de zas gos kyi bdag po mi byed par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhes pa nas/ thar pa yang skye la/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gal te skye ba blangs pa zhes pa nas/ phan pa yod kyis zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ tshe 'phos pa zhes sogs man ngag do/ /'o na bza' gtad dang bsur bsngo ba bstan pa med dam snyam na/ cho ga dang 'brel ba'i zas gtad gos lham gtod pa dang / bsur bsngos na phan yon yod par gsungs te/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ las kyi tha mar gyur pa na/ /zhen cing chags pa spangs pa'i phyir/ /zas gtad pa yi cho ga bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i cho ga ni/ 'od zer las/ yul kha cig na/ nub tha ma la/ gos lham gtod pa zhes bya ba'i lag len byed pa yod de/ de byed na tshe 'das lhar bsam pa de la/ 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa dang / /gos dang lham dang zan dang gtor ma la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs la 'bul lo zhes gsungs la/ 'di'i sogs khong nas/ bzhon pa dang / rgyan dang / bsur bsngod pa rnams bsdu'o/ /des na cho ga dang ma 'brel ba'i gshin po la ched du bsur bsngod pa'i khungs ma mthong zhing / rgyas par gong gi mdo 'di la dpyad pas gsal bar gda' lags/ dri ba so brgyad pa/ spor chog rang bzhin rnam dag dang / /chos kyi dbyings dang rten gyi gnas/ /gsum du 'chad pa sa skya pa'i/ /gong ma'i gsungs na gsal lags sam/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ spyir spor chog la/ chos kyi dbyings su gnas spor ba 'di/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab tu ma zad/ rgyud sde bzhi char gyi dgongs par gsungs te/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral/

/zhes rgyud du ma nas gsungs/ 'di bzhin rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab du mar 'byung lags/ rang bzhin rnam dag tu gnas par bya ba'i/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mos bde mchog dril bu pa'i dus mtha' ma'i cho ga dang / rje btsun chen pos gzhan phan bdud rtsi dang / gzhan phan nyer mkho gnyis su/ phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba lnga yi me sbor ro/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad de 'phrod pa de la/ rang bzhin rnam dag tu gnas spor ba zhes pa'i ming btags 'di la go don rgya che ste/ ma spros lags shing / dmigs pa rten gyi gnas su gnas spor ba 'di la/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ nub phyogs bde gnas lam bstan bya/ /lam ni bar chad bsal te sbyangs/ /zhes dang / slob dpon stong nyid ting 'dzin rdo rjes/ yang na rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing du 'o/ /zhes dang / 'od zer las/ de nas tshe 'das bde ba can du skyes par bsam zhes dang / gtsug dgu las kyang bde ba can du skye bar shog zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde ba can nam/ mngon dga'i zhing sogs rang gang 'dod pa'i zhing dmigs rten du byas te gnas spor bar gda'/ de ltar gang zag dang rnal 'byor pa dbang po rab dang rtogs pa rab kyi chos kyi dbyings dang / dbang gi rang bzhin rnam dag dang / tha mas rten gyi gnas su gnas spor ba'i lugs byas na legs shing / 'on kyang rang bzhin rnam dag la gya nom lhar zhen dang / dmigs pa rten gyi gnas la mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa yod pas/ de la 'khor gsum mi rtog pas rgyas theb pa gal che ba rang yin pa gda' lags/ de ltar na bdag bskyed la 'phros pa'i dri ba bcu gcig bum bskyed la 'phros pa'i dri ba bzhi/ mdun bskyed la 'phros pa'i dri ba dgu/ dbang dang bdag 'jug la 'phros pa'i dri ba lnga/ lho sgo'i cho ga la 'phros pa'i dri ba dgu ste/ dri ba so brgyad mdzad pa la lan mdor bsdus pa tsam gya tshoms su smras zin to/

/de dag gis ni chos rje rdzong pa'i srol 'dzin gyi lugs ltar bshad pa bstan zin te/ de ltar de dag gi ni dpal kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dka' gnad rnams dang log rtog sel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar legs bshad kun 'dus zhes bya ba ma lus bshad zin to// ༈ //'dir smras pa/ 'dir bshad ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gtam/ /'di 'dra mkhas mang 'dus pa'i do ra ru/ /'di zhes blo gsal rnams kyis bshad byas nas/ /'di phyir rang gzhan phan bde dpag med thob/ /da ltar kun rig cho ga'i dka' gnad dang / /log rtog sel byed legs bshad kun 'dus kyi/ /bstan bcos 'di ni sngon byon mkhas pa yi/ /gsung rab rnams las ji ltar 'byung bzhin bkod/ /mtshams sbyor tsam zhig kho bos bgyis pa la/ /nongs pa mchis na bdag gzhan dus gsum gyi/ /sdig dang lhan cig 'gyod pa chen pos bshags/ /phyin chad rnam smin 'byung bar ma gyur cig /lhag bsam dag pas sdebs legs rnam dkar gyi/ /dge ba dri med gangs ri ltar dkar des/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa cher rgyas zhing / /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can nyid du/ /skyes nas sa lam rtogs pa myur bsgrod de/ /gang la gang 'dul sprul pa srid mtha'i bar/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rgyas byed shog /ces dpal kun rig gi cho ga'i dka' gnad rnams dang log rtog sel bar byed pa'i bstan bcos ngo mtshar legs bshad kun 'dus zhes bya ba 'di yang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su ma mchis pa rje btsun mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i/ yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/

rje btsun sa skya pa'i bzhed srol dri ma med pa yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyun la phan pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa kho na'i dbang byas te/ na tshod ldan gyi lo sa ga zla ba'i dmar cha rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi chos rgyal 'phags pa'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi drung tshoms dmar nyid 'od 'khyil par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nyang stod bkras sgang pa dge bsnyen lhas sbyin gyis bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid la ji ltar re ba bzhin 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig bzang ldan pa yig mkhan rgan bu nor bu bkra shis kyi gus pas bgyis lags/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 146 a myes zhabs/ dpal kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i dka' gnad rnams dang log rtog sel byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 145
